原文: Giant bat
译文: 巨蝙蝠

原文: It reminds me something. If I remember correctly, it was a cult of demonists established in the Empire several centuries ago by a heretic named Lucius. He declared himself the Dark prophet of Satan and started to proclaim speedy fall of the God's earthly realm. He gathered numerous fanatics, which pinned their faith to him and supposed that before long the world will end. Eventually all were caught and burned, even though many of them were of high status. Why do you think judge Vallarian would be a part of the long dead cult? I'm sure there is plenty of new ones these days.
译文: 这让我想起了一些事。如果我没记错的话，那是数个世纪前在帝国境内由一个名叫卢修斯的异端所建立的恶魔崇拜教团。他自封为撒旦的暗黑先知，开始宣扬上帝的尘世国度将迅速覆灭。他聚集了众多狂信徒，他们将信仰寄托于他，认为世界不久便会终结。最终所有人都被抓获并烧死，尽管其中许多人身份显赫。你为什么认为瓦拉里安法官会与那个早已覆灭的教团有关？我敢肯定如今有的是新教团。

原文: My name is Edmond d'Arvias and I'm the superior of the Hillbrandt chapter of the Brotherhood of the Righteous!
译文: 我名叫埃德蒙·达尔维亚斯，是希尔布兰特正义兄弟会分会的长上！

原文: You are a Master of the order of the Brotherhood of the Righteous.
译文: 你是正义兄弟会的导师。

原文: Unbelievable! Are you telling me that Bishop Herbertius rose from his grave? That's infernal! And as if it was not enough, according to your words priest Romius was commanded by that spawn of darkness to steal the monstrance. A priest of the Holy Mother Church enthralled by infernal powers... I find it hard to believe, nevertheless I can't doubt your words. It is obvious that heresy has rooted itself deep in this town—it has infected even the ranks of the Church. Nevertheless I am glad to say that you completed your task with excellence! The monstrance is back and the perpetrator is revealed. That means I'm free to declare you a commander of the Brotherhood. That is if you've already proven your courage in fighting and killed more than a hundred enemies...
译文: 难以置信！你是说赫伯提乌斯主教从坟墓中爬了出来？这简直是地狱之物！更糟的是，据你所言，罗米乌斯牧师是受那黑暗之裔的命令偷走了圣体光。一位圣母教会的牧师被地狱之力蛊惑……我难以置信，但我不怀疑你的话。异端显然已在这座城镇深深扎根——甚至感染了教会内部。不过我很高兴地说，你出色地完成了任务！圣体光已寻回，罪魁祸首也已查明。这意味着我可以宣布你为兄弟会指挥官了。前提是你已在战斗中证明了勇气，并斩杀了一百多个敌人……

原文: I don't say that it's the most interesting event of these days, but I was in Salena Flock's pub and I overheard a conversation between that odd trader Ihman ab Sahab and priest Gilbert. The trader was persuading the priest to get him a copy of the Legend of Saint Orthenius from the ancient Killian's Chronicle which is stored in the archiepiscopal archives.
译文: 我可不是说这是最近最引人注目的事件，当时我在萨莱娜·弗洛克的酒馆里，无意间听到了那个古怪商人伊赫曼·阿布·萨哈布和牧师吉尔伯特的对话。那个商人正在说服这位牧师，替他从保存在大主教档案馆里的古老《基利安编年史》中抄录一份《圣奥塞尼乌斯传说》。

原文: Hmmm, doesn't ring the bell—I'm not very good with weapons. Well, try asking master smith Leon van den Brooks—I think it could be his work. Look at the arrowhead—it seems like very fine craftsmanship. By the way... whose blood is it? Oh... well, sorry for such a stupid question...
译文: 嗯，没印象——我不太懂武器。嗯，试试去问铸剑大师莱昂·范登布鲁克斯——我觉得这可能是他的作品。看看箭头——看起来工艺非常精湛。顺便说一句……上面是谁的血？哦……嗯，抱歉问了这么愚蠢的问题……

原文: Huh... thank you, knight. You've surprised me... I thought you'd just tell me I'm a goof-off who should bugger off. Thanks again. I'll have a toast to your health while drinking it away. What can I do for you?
译文: 嗯……谢谢你，骑士。你让我吃了一惊……我原以为你只会说我是个游手好闲的混蛋，让我滚远点。再次道谢。喝这酒时，我会为你干上一杯。有什么能为您效劳？

原文: Thanks, knight! God bless you... I'll have a toast to your health! What can I do for you?
译文: 谢谢，骑士！愿上帝保佑你……我这就为你干上一杯！有什么能为您效劳？

译文: 我研究什么？科学，骑士。占星术与炼金术为首——如果这听起来耳熟的话。

原文: Hans von Drichtmaul has a renowned armory in Glatzburg. You can get potions and various magic items from Enrie Jungwirdt, the wise woman, and from Paolus Ventimus, the alchemist. Wanda Gielwitch, the tavern owner, and Ludwig Weintraum the innkeeper have both variety of goods for sale. And you can barter anything at Alphonso DiCerbio's, if you don't mind the origin of the goods.
译文: 汉斯·冯·德里希特毛尔在格拉茨堡经营着一家颇有名气的军械铺。您可以从智者恩丽·容维特和炼金术士保卢斯·文提穆斯那里买到药水和各种魔法物品。酒馆老板旺达·吉尔维奇和旅店老板温特劳姆（路德维希）都有各式各样的货物出售。至于阿方索·迪切尔比奥那里，只要您不介意货品的来路，什么都能讨价还价。

原文: Of course I know about the Children of the New Order. It was a cult gathered around certain Lucius in the tenth century. Lucius declared himself the Dark prophet and proclaimed the end of the world and coming of a perverted new order. Its children were supposed to rule the world alongside with Satan. The cult was dangerous in that it grew through all the layers of society and involved even the highest classes—both secular and clerical. Despite of that the Holy Office managed to uncover the heretics and execute them including Lucius in 1021. All that fortunately happened in the Empire, hundreds of miles away from the Realm. Thereby I'm very unnerved by notion the cult might have survived and even relocated itself here to Ultherst.
译文: 我当然知道新秩序之子。那是一个围绕十世纪某个卢修斯聚集的邪教。卢修斯自封为暗黑先知，宣告世界末日与一个堕落新秩序的降临。他的子民要与撒旦一同统治世界。该邪教之所以危险，在于它渗透了社会各阶层，甚至连最高层——世俗与教会——都未能幸免。即便如此，圣务院还是于1021年查明了这些异端并将其处决，卢修斯亦在其中。所幸这一切发生在帝国境内，距王国足有数百英里。因此，当想到该邪教或许幸存至今，甚至已迁至乌尔瑟斯特时，我深感不安。

原文: Jean de Guise, the seneschal of the Brotherhood of the Righteous, made confession before his death. He confessed he was member of the Children of the New Order and he named you as a dark high priest of the cult, Your Excellency.
译文: 正义兄弟会的家宰让·德·吉斯在临死前作了供述。他供认自己是新秩序之子的成员，并指认你就是该邪教的黑暗大祭司，阁下。

原文: Jean de Guise, the seneschal of the Brotherhood of the Righteous, made a confession before his death. He confessed he was member of the Children of the New Order and he named you as a dark high priest of the cult, Your Excellency.

原文: How is it possible you've never heard about Saint Berthold's Night? Well, it all happened in the Empire in 1215 on Saint Berthold's Day. Prince Henry, an orthodox believer and heir to the throne, was supposed to marry Kathryn de Valion, a daughter of reformist King Hugo III. Prince Henry's mother wanted to prevent the wedding at any cost, so she exploited growing animosity between the orthodox believers and the reformists to initiate a huge nightlong massacre in which almost ten thousands reformists were slaughtered. It was the end of the Saint-Generiel religious reconciliation and the start of schism in all the faithful world. Nevertheless it purged the Empire of reformists—thoroughly.
译文: 你竟然没听说过圣伯特霍尔德之夜？这怎么可能？事情发生在1215年的帝国，那天是圣伯特霍尔德日。亨利王子是正统派信徒和王位继承人，本该迎娶改革派的雨果三世国王之女凯瑟琳·德·瓦利翁。亨利王子的母亲不惜一切代价想阻止这场婚姻，于是她利用正统派与改革派之间日益加深的仇怨，挑起了一场持续整整一夜的大屠杀，近万名改革派被屠戮殆尽。圣热内列尔宗教和解就此终结，信仰世界的大分裂由此开端。尽管如此，帝国确被彻底肃清了改革派——干干净净。

原文: I saw priest Romius and I'm worried about his health. Has he come to you for advice lately?
译文: 我见到了罗米乌斯神父，对他的健康状况很担心。他最近来找过你咨询吗？

原文: Exactly, knight. Tom had persuaded his father in the end, that if he was not needed in Duke van Leerin's house, he could come here to learn smithing. So he would spend all his free time here. But then he didn't show up for some time. And that was strange. In the end I went to his father to ask him if he was ill or something and he brushed me off saying that his son was not my problem. And that was even stranger because we've always been on good terms.
译文: 正是如此，骑士。汤姆最终说服了他父亲，说如果范·勒林公爵府上用不着他，他就可以来这里学习锻造。这样他就可以把所有空闲时间都耗在这里。可是后来他有好一阵子没露面。这就奇怪了。最后我去找他父亲，问他是不是病了还是怎么了，结果他把我打发了，说他儿子的事与我无关。这就更奇怪了，因为我们向来关系不错。

译文: 人们说他把自己封闭起来，几乎不再说话。他整日借酒浇愁，身体每况愈下。

原文: Of course I've heard about the hammer of Bonhart von Drichtmaul. Bonhart was said to be able to make real wonders with it. I've also heard that he buried it somewhere before he went to the Barbarian Wars in 977—to keep it from falling in the hands of some thieving mongrel but nobody knows where he buried it...
译文: 我当然听说过邦哈特·冯·德里希特毛尔之锤。据说邦哈特用它能创造真正的奇迹。我还听说他在977年参加蛮族战争之前把它埋在了某个地方——以免落入某个盗贼杂种手中，但没人知道他把它埋在哪里……

原文: It was not her who turned Knight d'Blazier into the stone. She confused his head indeed, but love is not a crime at all. Sandra Ullmann is behind his petrifaction. She was the witch practicing dark spells. On the basis of presented proofs she confessed that she cursed Paladin Richwald d'Blazier for resisting her infernal temptation and for refusing to become her lover!
译文: 将布拉齐耶爵士化为顽石的并非她。她确实令他神魂颠倒，但爱情本身绝不是罪过。石化的幕后黑手是桑德拉·乌尔曼。施行黑暗咒术的女巫是她。依据呈交的证据，她已供认：正是圣骑士里奇瓦尔德·德·布拉齐耶抗拒她的地狱诱惑、拒绝成为她的情人，她才对他降下了诅咒！

原文: I do know something about the cult of the Children of the New Order. If I remember it well, it was a rather numerous and quickly spreading cult of the demon-invocators that was created in the Empire during the restless times at the end of the tenth century. The cult was founded by a self-appointed Dark Prophet named Lucius who foretold the End of the World and the release of Satan from his one thousand years imprisonment. Soon the cult found some members also among the gentry and nobles and then it became a really dangerous movement, which was a hard nut to crack for the Inquisition. Fortunately for Ultherst the cult of the Children of the New Order didn't spread into the other faithful countries and because of that we were spared from the grim raging of the Holy Office. What came to pass in the end was what had to come to pass—all members of the cult were caught and executed, including the members of the Emperor's family. Several hundred heretics were burned in the Emperor's Square in Bonorium in 1021. And that was the end of the cult of the Children of the New Order.
译文: 我对新秩序之子教团确实略知一二。若我记得没错，那是个人数众多、蔓延迅速的召唤恶魔者教团，于十世纪末的动荡年代在帝国境内兴起。教团由一个自称暗黑先知、名为卢修斯的人创立，他预言了世界末日，以及撒旦将从千年囚禁中被释放。不久，教团在乡绅阶层与贵族中也吸纳了些许成员，遂成了一股真正危险的势力，令宗教裁判所颇为棘手。所幸的是，新秩序之子教团并未蔓延至其他信仰虔诚的国家，我们因此免于圣务院的残酷蹂躏。最终，该发生的事终究发生了——教团全体成员尽数被捕处决，其中包括皇帝家族的成员。1021年，数百名异端在博诺里乌姆的皇帝广场被处以火刑。新秩序之子教团也就此覆灭。

原文: Excellent, that should be enough. In the end it doesn't look as bad as I thought at the beginning. I was worried both of us will be in really big trouble. Many people will probably ask many questions about many things even now, but with this evidence I can stand out with a clear conscience and say that I revealed the truth about Duke Rowan van Leerin and that I put him to death in self-defense, as he resisted me during the apprehension. Thank you, brother. I think my promotion to the Seneschal position is only a matter of time. Great!
译文: 很好，这些应该够了。最终看来，情况并没有我一开始想的那么糟。我原本担心我们俩都要大难临头了。即使现在，仍会有许多人对许多事情提出许多疑问，但有了这些证据，我就能问心无愧地站出来说：是我揭开了罗文·范·勒林公爵的真相，是他抗拒拘捕，我出于自卫才将他处死。谢谢你，兄弟。我想我升任家宰只是时间问题。太好了！

原文: Really? Well, this is what I call sound evidence. Excellent, brother. With this evidence I can stand out with a clear conscience and say that I revealed the truth about Duke Rowan van Leerin and that I put him to death in self-defense, as he resisted me during the apprehension. Thank you, brother. I think my promotion to the Seneschal position is only a matter of time. Great!
译文: 当真？嗯，这才叫铁证如山。很好，兄弟。凭此证据，我可以问心无愧地站出来，宣称是我揭穿了罗文·范·勒林公爵的真相，并在他拒捕时出于自卫将其处死。谢谢你，兄弟。我想我升任家宰不过是时间问题。太好了！

原文: Hail to you, brother. What brings you to me? I'm awaiting a courier from Alvaron impatiently, as he should bring me news from my superiors. Sure I'll be promoted to the Seneschal status and be transferred to the Citadel of the Brotherhood...
译文: 向你致敬，兄弟。是什么风把你吹来了？我正心急地等着阿尔瓦伦来的信使，他应当会带来上级的消息。我肯定会升任家宰，然后调往兄弟会的城堡要塞……

原文: Excellent, that should be enough. In the end it doesn't look as bad as I thought at the beginning. I was worried both of us will be in really big trouble. Many people will probably ask many questions about many things even now, but with this evidence I can stand out with a clear conscience and say that I revealed the truth about Duke Rowan van Leerin and that I put him to death in self-defense, as he resisted me during the apprehension. Thank you, Father. I think my promotion to the Seneschal position is only a matter of time. Great!
译文: 太好了，这些应该足够了。事情并没有我最初想象的那么糟。我原本担心我们俩都会陷入大麻烦。即便现在，也免不了有许多人对许多事问东问西，但有了这些证据，我便能坦然站出来说：是我揭开了罗文·范·勒林公爵的真面目，并且在他拒捕时出于自卫将他处死。谢谢你，神父。我想，我升任家宰不过是时间问题。太好了！

原文: Yes, that's exactly what I want, Father. I want you to find the spirit of Baron Dawn von Blutenreich and to banish him from his house and completely out of this world. I would have it done on my own.. well, supernatural powers I can't handle, but what I can handle are bears. Moreover my health isn't what it used to be any more. I'm not the fighter I used to be since that hunt when a black bear broke my knee...
译文: 是的，正是如此，神父。我要你找到道恩·冯·布卢滕里希男爵的亡灵，将他从他的宅邸中驱逐，彻底逐出这个世界。我本想亲自去办……好吧，超自然的力量我应付不来，但熊我还对付得了。况且我的身体也不如从前了。自从那次狩猎中一头黑熊打断了我的膝盖，我就不再是从前那个战士了。

原文: Yes, that's exactly what I want, sir. I want you to find the spirit of Baron Dawn von Blutenreich and to banish him from his house and completely out of this world. I would have it done on my own.. well, supernatural powers I can't handle, but what I can handle are bears. Moreover my health isn't what it used to be any more. I'm not the fighter I used to be since that hunt when a black bear broke my knee...
译文: 没错，正是如此，大人。我要你找到道恩·冯·布卢滕里希男爵的灵魂，将他逐出宅邸，彻底赶出这个世界。我本想亲自处理……嗯，超自然的力量我应付不了，但对付熊我还是在行的。况且我的身体大不如前了。自从那次狩猎中一头黑熊撞断了我的膝盖，我就再也不是从前那个战士了。

原文: No, knight, nobody did. I even told Master Dieter von Gelbendiel himself about it—he's the local Magister of the Chapter of the Brotherhood of the Righteous. He indeed promised to deal with the case immediately, because it's not the first case of kidnapping here in the city, but I haven't heard a word from him since.
译文: 没有，骑士，一个都没有。我甚至亲自把这件事告诉了迪特尔·冯·盖尔本迪尔大人——他是正义兄弟会分会的本地大师。他确实答应立即处理此案，因为这已经不是城里第一起绑架案了，但从那以后我再没听到他的任何消息。

原文: No, Father, nobody did. I even told Master Dieter von Gelbendiel himself about it—he's the local Magister of the Chapter of the Brotherhood of the Righteous. He indeed promised to deal with the case immediately, because it's not the first case of kidnapping here in the city, but I haven't heard a word from him since.
译文: 没有，神父，没人管这件事。我甚至亲自把这事告诉了迪特尔·冯·盖尔本迪尔大人——他是正义兄弟会分会的教务长。他确实答应立即着手处理，因为这已经不是城里第一起绑架案了，可从那以后我再没听到他半个字。

原文: No, noble lord, nobody did. I even told Master Dieter von Gelbendiel himself about it—he's the local Magister of the Chapter of the Brotherhood of the Righteous. He indeed promised to deal with the case immediately, because it's not the first case of kidnapping here in the city, but I haven't heard a word from him since.
译文: 不，贵族大人，没有人这么做。我甚至亲自把这件事告诉了迪特尔·冯·盖尔本迪尔大人本人——他是正义兄弟会分会的本地最高导师。他的确答应会立即处理此案，因为这已经不是这座城市里第一桩绑架案了，但从那以后我再没听到他的任何消息。

原文: Yes, I do. I've managed to get the confession of two persons who testified that two years ago Duke Verenicus had allowed two unknown men into the royal palace and then performed a heretical rite with them in the chambers of Prince Louis. That rite led to the tragic death of the Crown Prince, as is commonly known.
译文: 是的，我掌握。我设法获得了两个人的供词，他们证实两年前维雷尼库斯公爵将两名身份不明的男子放入王宫，随后在路易王子的寝宫中与他们一同进行了异端仪式。众所周知，那场仪式导致了王太子的悲剧性死亡。

原文: Yes, I do. According to the confession of Sven Larsen Seneschal Jean de Guise ordered the murder of the paladin Eradim d'Chambrie because the paladin decided to denounce the Seneschal to the Inquisition. Then I managed to get the confession of Seneschal's underling Downay who confessed he perpetrated many disgusting crimes at Seneschal's bidding. And finally I have the confession of the royal counselor Verenicus who pleaded he threw a dark curse upon Prince Louis together with Jean de Guise two years ago!
译文: 有的。据斯文·拉森供述，管家让·德·吉斯下令谋杀了圣骑士埃拉迪姆·德·尚布里，因为这名圣骑士打算向宗教裁判所揭发管家。此后，我设法取得了管家的部下道奈的供词，他承认自己奉管家之命犯下了许多令人发指的罪行。最后，我还有皇家顾问维雷尼库斯的供词——他亲口承认，两年前他曾与让·德·吉斯一同对路易王子施下了黑暗诅咒！

原文: I'd like to ask you about one thing, Seneschal. The former gardener Downay branded you as a heretic and a member of the cult of the Children of the New Order. What can you tell me about it?
译文: 家宰，我想向你打听一件事。前任园丁道奈指控你是异端，是新秩序之子教团的成员。对此你有什么要说的？

原文: You had better answer me, Seneschal. I wouldn't advise you to conceal anything. That would be very unwise of you, if you understand me.
译文: 你最好回答我，家宰。我劝你不要隐瞒任何事。那将是非常不明智的，如果你明白我的意思的话。

原文: You are wise and powerful man, Seneschal. Your answer would be of the greatest help to me.
译文: 您是睿智而强大的人，家宰。您的回答将对我有莫大帮助。

原文: We will see, Seneschal. Now please present to me all the evidence against Grand Master de Malamert you've managed to get.
译文: 我们走着瞧，家宰。现在，请把你所收集到的针对德·马拉梅特大团长的一切证据呈交给我。

原文: Thank you, Seneschal. I will present this evidence to the Supreme Tribunal of Inquisition.
译文: 谢谢你，家宰。我会将这些证据呈交给宗教裁判所最高审判庭。

原文: Thank you. But before I put my mind to the case, I'd like you to answer a few questions, Seneschal.
译文: 谢谢。但在着手办理此案之前，我想请你先回答几个问题，家宰。

原文: No, I'm sorry for not introducing myself. My name's Jeane de Guise and I'm a Seneschal of the Brotherhood of the Righteous. But my name probably doesn't mean anything to you, and neither does my face. Nevertheless I know you and you know me, because we met once. You surely remember two men who visited you this spring and asked you to investigate strange events in the town of Hillbrandt...
译文: 不，是我该抱歉没有自报家门。我叫让·德·吉斯，是正义兄弟会的家宰。不过我的名字对你大概毫无意义，我的面孔同样如此。尽管如此，我认得你，你也认得我，因为我们曾见过一面。你一定记得今年春天有两个人前来拜访你，请求你调查希尔布兰特镇上发生的怪事……

原文: I think the time has come for you to tell me all, Seneschal. I've risked my life to get here.
译文: 家宰，我想你该把一切都告诉我了。我冒死才来到这里。

原文: You use the plural, Seneschal. In whose name do you speak and who are your enemies? What do you know about them?
译文: 你用的是复数，家宰。你以谁的名义说话？你的敌人又是谁？你对他们了解多少？

原文: In that case I may greatly enhance your knowledge, Seneschal. The heretics you fight against belong to the cult of the Children of the New Order. Kurt Ollmier got the book Libre Daemonium for them, which describes rites for summoning the Fallen Angels. And that's precisely what the heretics are trying to do—to summon those infernal demons.
译文: 那我正好可以大大增进您的见识，家宰。您所对抗的异端属于新秩序之子教团。库尔特·奥尔米尔为他们取得了《恶魔之书》，书中记载了召唤堕落天使的仪式。而异端们正试图做的，恰恰就是召唤那些地狱恶魔。

原文: What are you talking about, Seneschal?
译文: 您在说什么，家宰？

原文: It seems so. What do you suggest, Seneschal?
译文: 看来确实如此。您有什么建议，家宰？

原文: I'm not sure if I'm the right person, Seneschal. Nobody knows me in Alvaron.
译文: 我不确定自己是否是合适的人选，家宰。在阿尔瓦隆没有人认识我。

原文: What if I would say I don't know what you are talking about, Seneschal?
译文: 如果我说我不知道你在说什么，家宰，你会怎么说？

原文: I understand. It's wise to be cautious these days. If you really don't believe me, I'll gladly give you proof of my words. In the spring we asked you to investigate the case of Kurt Ollmier the merchant, because we suspected he gained possession of some rare heretical relic or text. Now you see it was really me who sought you out then.
译文: 我明白。如今谨慎行事是明智的。如果你真的不相信我，我很乐意为此提供证据。春天时我们请你调查商人库尔特·奥尔米尔的案子，因为我们怀疑他获得了一件罕见的异端遗物或文献。现在你明白了，那时来找你的确实是我。

原文: Not yet, Seneschal. You have to be patient.
译文: 还没有，家宰。你必须要有耐心。

原文: I'd like to ask you a few questions, Seneschal.
译文: 我想问你几个问题，家宰。

原文: Yes, maybe. But now I'd like to ask you a few questions, Seneschal
译文: 是的，也许吧。不过现在我想问你几个问题，家宰。

原文: I can't help you, Seneschal. Nobody can heal such serious wounds. You should have given up!
译文: 我帮不了你，家宰。这样的重伤无人能治。你本该早点收手的！

原文: Your life is forfeit, Seneschal. But your soul has hope for salvation. Make confession. Open your soul to God and admit your sins. As you can see, the infernal powers have forsaken you. They've let you to fall and haven't helped you. But God may forgive you. Don't deprive yourself of the chance of eternal life!
译文: 你的性命已不属于自己，家宰。但你的灵魂尚有获得救赎的希望。忏悔吧。向主敞开心扉，坦承你的罪孽。如你所见，地狱的力量已经抛弃了他们。他们任你坠落，未曾伸出援手。但上帝或许会宽恕你。不要亲手断送获得永生的机会！

原文: Cardinal Commendoni? Inquisitor General of the Holy Office? Why should I believe you, Seneschal?
译文: 科门多尼枢机主教？圣务院的审判官总长？我为什么要相信你，管家？

原文: It's up to you, brother. I... am not lying to you. Listen carefully, I won't be able to resist death for too long... He sent his dark priests to search for the book Libre Daemonium, describing the rite of summoning of the Fallen Angels. He entrusted Vallarian and Truncquillius with summoning of Arthamon and Baphomet. He prepares to open the gates of Hell and to free the Prince of Darkness from his thousand-year prison. He... My God... aaaah...
译文: 全看你的了，兄弟。我……没有骗你。仔细听好，我撑不了太久了……他派出黑暗牧师搜寻《恶魔之书》，书中记载着召唤堕落天使的仪式。他把召唤阿尔萨蒙和巴弗默的任务交给了瓦拉里安和特伦奎利乌斯。他正准备打开地狱之门，把黑暗王子从千年的囚禁中释放出来。他……我的上帝……啊啊啊……

原文: Seneschal, do you hear me? Have Arthamon and Baphomet been really summoned? Where are they? Is it possible to stop them somehow? And who was charged with summoning the Fallen Angel Cerdie? Seneschal?
译文: 家宰，你听见了吗？阿尔萨蒙和巴弗默真的被召唤出来了吗？他们在哪里？有没有办法阻止他们？还有，是谁受命召唤堕落天使塞尔迪？家宰？

原文: You better answer me, Seneschal. I wouldn't advise you to conceal anything from the Inquisition. That would be very unwise of you, if you understand me.
译文: 你最好回答我，家宰。我不会建议你对宗教裁判所隐瞒任何事。那可是极不明智的，如果你明白我的意思。

原文: It's up to you, Father. I... am not lying to you. Listen carefully, I won't be able to resist death for too long... He sent his dark priests to search for the book Libre Daemonium, describing the rite of summoning of the Fallen Angels. He entrusted Vallarian and Truncquillius with summoning of Arthamon and Baphomet. He prepares to open the gates of Hell and to free the Prince of Darkness from his thousand-year prison. He... My God... aaaah...
译文: 信不信由您，大人。我……没有骗您。仔细听，我撑不了多久了……他派出黑暗祭司去寻找《恶魔之书》，书中记载着召唤堕落天使的仪式。他将召唤阿尔萨蒙与巴风特之事托付给了瓦拉里安和特隆奎利乌斯。他准备打开地狱之门，将黑暗王子从千年囚禁中释放出来。他……我的上帝……啊……

原文: You should answer me, Seneschal. I wouldn't advise you to conceal anything. That would be very unwise of you, if you understand me.
译文: 您应该回答我，家宰。我奉劝您不要隐瞒任何事情。如果您明白我的意思，那样做是非常不明智的。

原文: It's up to you, sir. I... am not lying to you. Listen carefully, I won't be able to resist death for too long... He sent his dark priests to search for the book Libre Daemonium, describing the rite of summoning of the Fallen Angels. He entrusted Vallarian and Truncquillius with summoning of Arthamon and Baphomet. He prepares to open the gates of Hell and to free the Prince of Darkness from his thousand-year prison. He... My God... aaaah...
译文: 由您来判断，大人。我……没有骗您。仔细听好，我撑不了太久了……他派出了黑暗祭司去搜寻禁书《恶魔之书》，书中记载着召唤堕落天使的仪式。他将召唤阿尔萨蒙和巴风特的任务交给了瓦拉里安和特隆奎利乌斯。他正准备打开地狱之门，释放黑暗王子脱离千年的囚禁。他……天哪……啊啊……

原文: You will never get her, do you understand? Never! I won't give over what I've gotten the possession of. That sinful whore is mine! I will lead her onto the executioner's stake and will let her watch the flames licking her legs like wanton tongues of infernal tempters! I'll let her scream with pain and horror, I'll let her burn in her own hell!
译文: 你休想得到她，明白吗？休想！我绝不会交出已经占有的东西。那个罪孽深重的婊子是我的！我要把她押上火刑柱，让她亲眼看着烈焰舔舐她的双腿，如同地狱诱惑者淫荡的舌头！我要让她在痛苦与恐惧中尖叫，让她在自己的地狱中燃烧！

原文: Fae'Darlion? Hmm... The name doesn't ring a bell. As well as most of the names coming from the ancient Elenian civilization. I've never studied history in such a degree to get deeper knowledge about that ancient era. But people say there are ancient ruins from the times before Ereborn in the vicinity of Baron Edger von Hunth's homestead. So you should direct your search in that direction.
译文: 法埃达利翁？唔……这名字没印象。大部分来自古代艾伦尼亚文明的名字都是如此。我从未深入研习历史，对那个古老时代所知有限。但据说在埃德格·冯·洪特男爵的宅邸附近，有埃雷博恩时代之前的远古遗迹。所以你应当朝那个方向寻找。

原文: ...We pray to you, God Almighty, for the salvation of our fallen brother Konrad von Thaum. Being led by the most noble of urges, he threw himself into the lion's den to lay his life on the altar of divine justice. Regrettably, this brave deed deprived the Brotherhood of the Righteous of two of its great supports—of Master Konrad von Thaum and of his sword called Decapitator, which served him faithfully till his death decapitating legions of enemies like fields of grain. We've lost both the life of our beloved leader and friend and the relic which was in the possession of the Brotherhood of the Righteous for several hundred years. And now...

You know, when you start liking girls and you feel like the king of the world thinking nothing can ever happen to you. Well, something happened to me. I was caught by Baron Trow von Ulbracht having fun with his only daughter in a barn. He got furious and it almost cost me my life. He started yelling that I had dishonored his only daughter, slashing his sword around so violently that he almost hit his naughty daughter. I managed to run away to my village but the next day the Baron came, resolved to have me executed. Things were getting tough—as the son of a poor peasant I had no means of defending myself so I took the only chance I had at the time. I joined the party of Paul Wachthremm. At the time, he believed he would be the person to free the Holy Grave of the First Prophet from the dirty pagan hands of the Jad-Habaal Empire and answered Pope Pius' call for a crusade. I accepted the cross and ended up in the Duke's army.

原文: First, the war was going well, I must say. With King Bert of Tenerick, who was already called the Iron King at the time, at the head of the army, we fought our way to Jevaran. We managed to conquer it after several months and thus we freed the Holy Grave of the First Prophet. At that time we thought nothing could stop us and nothing could stop the victory of the true faith over the pagans. So we went on to the center of Jad-Habaal. The pagans would only send small untrained units who didn't stand a chance against our cavalry. We were crushing them under the hooves of our horses and conquering miles. We defeated some of their cities and many strongholds and we were positive the final victory was at hand. But, we were awfully wrong. After conquering Nafrat we found out about a huge army of pagans coming from the south. Before we could do anything we were cut off. The land we had conquered. including Jevaran, fell back to the hands of pagans and we were under siege in Nafrat. The three years I spent there made me thirty years older, knight. The situation was desperate. We were able to hold the walls but the numbers of the Jad-Habaal bastards were infinite. It was like looking at an endless sea.
译文: 首先，我得说，战争进行得很顺利。特内里克国王伯特——当时已被称作铁王——率领大军，我们一路杀到杰瓦兰。数月之后我们终于攻陷了它，从而解放了先知圣墓。那时我们以为没有什么能阻挡我们，没有什么能阻止真正信仰对异教徒的胜利。于是我们继续深入贾德-哈巴尔腹地。异教徒只派出小股未经训练的部队，在我们的骑兵面前毫无胜算。我们将他们踩在马蹄之下，一里又一里地攻城略地。我们攻破了他们的数座城池和诸多要塞，坚信最终胜利已近在眼前。但我们大错特错了。攻占纳夫拉特之后，我们得知一支庞大的异教军队正从南方逼近。还没等我们做出反应，退路便被切断了。我们攻占的土地。包括杰瓦兰，重新落入异教徒之手，而我们被困在纳夫拉特，遭到围困。我在那里度过的三年，让我老了三十岁，骑士。局势岌岌可危。我们还能守住城墙，但贾德-哈巴尔杂种的数量无穷无尽。就像望着一片无边无际的大海。

原文: First, the war was going well, I must say. With King Bert of Tenerick, who was already called the Iron King at the time, at the head of the army, we fought our way to Jevaran. We managed to conquer it after several months and thus we freed the Holy Grave of the First Prophet. At that time we thought nothing could stop us and nothing could stop the victory of the true faith over the pagans. So we went on to the center of Jad-Habaal. The pagans would only send small untrained units who didn't stand a chance against our cavalry. We were crushing them under the hooves of our horses and conquering miles. We defeated some of their cities and many strongholds and we were positive the final victory was at hand. But, we were awfully wrong. After conquering Nafrat we found out about a huge army of pagans coming from the south. Before we could do anything we were cut off. The land we had conquered. including Jevaran, fell back to the hands of pagans and we were under siege in Nafrat. The three years I spent there made me thirty years older, noble sir. The situation was desperate. We were able to hold the walls but the numbers of the Jad-Habaal bastards were infinite. It was like looking at an endless sea.

译文: 他们在百年战争末期的黑暗岁月中活动，那是十世纪的事。他们的首领名叫卢修斯——他是暗黑先知，也是该邪教的高阶牧师。正是他预言了人间神国的终结，以及撒旦自牢狱中的释放。他宣扬旧世界即将覆灭、新秩序即将降临——新秩序的子嗣将统治那些被蛊惑的义人灵魂，而这些人将在这一过程中死于刀剑与烈火。尽管这邪教渗透进了帝国最高的社会阶层，它仍落得一个惨烈下场。所有教徒——包括卢修斯——都被处以极刑。活活烧死。他们的结局便是如此。可如今看来，事情似乎并非如此。您发现了什么，贵族大人？您为何要追查那个邪教？我翻译的那卷羊皮卷提到了召唤堕落天使。那卷羊皮卷是谁的？它怎么会落到您的手里？

原文: They were acting in the dark ages at the end of the Hundred Years War, that's in the tenth century. They were led by certain Lucius—he was a Dark Prophet and the High Priest of the cult. That was him who prophesized the end of the Kingdom of God on Earth and the release of Satan from his prison. He was preaching about the end of the Old World and about coming of a New Order—Its children were supposed to rule the enthralled souls of the righteous who were to be killed by sword and fire in the process. Although the cult infiltrated the highest social ranks of the Empire it met a gruesome end. All the cultists—including Lucius—were executed. Burnt. And that was their end. Well, but it seems now that it wasn't quite true. What did you discover, noble lord? Why are you looking for that cult? That scroll I translated mentioned summoning of the Fallen Angels. Whose scroll was it? How did it come into your possession?

原文: A good observation, noble lord. Well, I have an ancient Elenian amulet in my possession, but I was not able to find out any details about it, thus I have absolutely no idea whether it could be the Sun Charm of priests serving Ael'Erthen. Well, anyway it can't do any harm to lend it to you. But you must promise me to return it when you're finished—it's very precious to me!
译文: 观察得很敏锐，贵族大人。我手中确实有一枚古老的艾伦尼亚护身符，但一直未能查明它的细节，因此我完全无法确定它是否就是侍奉艾尔·埃尔森的祭司们所持的太阳护符。不过，借给您倒也无妨。但您必须向我保证，用完后归还——它对我非常珍贵！

原文: Really? That's splendid, knight! I'm sure that it will help us to make great discoveries in the field of alchemy! That it will allow us to unveil some of the secrets of Elenian mages and will reveal a bit of the mystery shrouding the Elenian civilization. Entire generations will be learning from my discoveries...
译文: 真的吗？太好了，骑士！我相信它将帮助我们在炼金术领域取得重大发现！它将使我们揭开艾伦尼亚法师的一些秘密，并揭示笼罩在艾伦尼亚人的文明之上的些许谜团。世世代代都将从我的发现中学习……

原文: Really? That's splendid, noble lord! I'm sure that it will help us to make great discoveries in the field of alchemy! That it will allow us to unveil some of the secrets of Elenian mages and will reveal a bit of the mystery shrouding the Elenian civilization. Entire generations will be learning from my discoveries...
译文: 真的吗？太好了，贵族大人！我相信它必将帮助我们在炼金术领域取得伟大的发现！它将使我们揭开艾伦尼亚法师的一些秘密，并揭示笼罩着艾伦尼亚人的文明的谜团的一角。世世代代的后人都将从我的发现中受益……

原文: Son, you're a hopeless case it seems. You've been investigating the greatest case of heresy and conspiracy in the history of the Realm and now when you discover the main culprit you have no idea what it was all about. Anyway, I'm going to explain it to you because I want to ask you a single question which you wouldn't be able to answer without comprehending everything. Very well—the summoning of the Fallen Angels mentioned in the Plan of the Dark Prophet Lucius was not intended to bring their physical projection into our world but rather to invoke the infernal powers they represent. That means Satan will be summoned regardless of the physical presence of Arthamon, Baphomet or Cerdie in our world—the only thing that matters are their infernal powers. And those have been irrecoverably unleashed! Just look around and tell me, do your really think that there's still the Kingdom of God on Earth as described by the Holy Scriptures? I don't think so—just the contrary. I can see only mortal sins—one alongside another. People are killing each other, they're given to fits of rage and are fornicating with each other regardless of law or order. That's what I call Hell!
译文: 孩子，看来你真是无可救药了。你一直在调查王国历史上最大规模的异端与阴谋案，如今终于挖出了主谋，却对这一切的来龙去脉一无所知。不过，我还是会向你解释清楚，因为我要问你一个问题——若你不明白这一切，便无法回答。很好——暗黑先知卢修斯的计划中提到的召唤堕落天使，并非为了将他们的实体投影带到我们的世界，而是为了唤起他们所代表的地狱之力。这意味着，无论阿尔萨蒙、巴风特或瑟迪是否以实体存在于我们的世界，撒旦都会被召唤——唯一重要的是他们的地狱之力。而那些力量已经不可挽回地释放出来了！环顾四周，告诉我，你真的认为圣典所描述的人间神国还存在吗？我可不这么认为——恰恰相反。我只看到致命的罪孽——接二连三。人们互相残杀，动辄暴怒失控，无视律法秩序淫乱苟合。这就是我所说的地狱！

原文: No, my son—that's brilliant! You'll see for yourself real soon. As you can see, the Dark Prophet Lucius planned and prepared everything to the tiniest detail—of course with the assistance from the Fallen Archangel Azrael. All that needed to be done was to wait for the right moment. The Holy Scripture, the Revelation of Saint Ezekiel—to be more specific, says that Satan will be released from his prison after a thousand years. Of course it's a nonsense which was introduced by Ezekiel's imagination, or better to say by delirium tremens caused by unrestrained drinking. Nevertheless, common people were influenced greatly. As soon as the year 1223 started to loom, people began to be scared of the end of the world, because they believed that the beginning of the God's Kingdom on Earth dated back to 223 when the pagan Empire of Ereborn fell and faithful kingdoms were born. Of course that's nonsense as well. Well, but it was an opportunity we could not just let go!
译文: 不，我的孩子——这简直是天才之举！你很快就会亲眼看到的。如你所见，暗黑先知卢修斯将一切筹划得细致入微——当然，这离不开堕落大天使阿兹瑞尔的协助。所需做的不过是等待恰当的时机。圣典——更确切地说是圣以西结启示录——宣称撒旦将在千年后从牢狱中获释。当然，这是以西结的胡思乱想，或者更准确地说，是他酗酒无度引发的震颤谵妄。然而，普通民众深受其影响。当1223年日渐临近，人们开始惧怕世界末日，因为他们相信人间神国始于223年，那一年异教的埃雷博恩帝国覆灭，虔诚的王国应运而生。当然，那同样是无稽之谈。但这可是我们不能错过的良机！

原文: I don't think that I, as the head of the Holy Mother Church of the Ultherst Nation, would be the most competent to inform you about heretical cults—it's the mission of the inquisitors, isn't it? Nevertheless I know the name, of course. It was a cult which originated in the Empire in the 10th century. According to rumors it was founded by a certain Lucius; a self-proclaimed Dark Prophet. He prognosticated the end of the world and the birth of a new order—its children were supposed to rule the world by the side of the Lord of Darkness himself. The danger of the cult lay in its ability to permeate all social strata and to infect even the highest ranks of the Church and the nobility of the Empire. Nevertheless, the papal Holy Office managed to discover the heretics in the end and they were all executed in 1021, including Lucius. Then the cult perished and there has been no word about it since.
译文: 我想，身为乌尔瑟斯民族圣母教会的领袖，我恐怕并非向你介绍异端教团最合适的人选——那是审判官们的使命，不是吗？不过，这个名字我当然是知道的。它是一个源自帝国、起于十世纪的教团。据传闻，它由一个名叫卢修斯的人创立——一个自称暗黑先知的家伙。他预言世界末日与新秩序的降临——新秩序之子将站在黑暗之主身旁统治世界。该教团的危险在于，它能够渗透各个社会阶层，甚至感染教会最高层与帝国贵族。然而，教廷圣务院最终还是查出了这些异端，他们于1021年被尽数处决，卢修斯亦在其列。此后教团便消亡了，再无半点消息。

原文: No, he didn't. Nevertheless the ritual should be described in the book Libre Daemonium which was in Commendoni's possession, probably hidden among his personal belongings...
译文: 不，他没有。然而，仪式的步骤应当记载于《恶魔之书》中，那本书原本归科门多尼所有，大概藏在他的私人物品之中……

原文: We've already talked about Jean de Guise, the seneschal of the Brotherhood of the Righteous, son. I must express again my sorrow about the matter—the situation his treachery led us into and the fact that so many people perished because of his betrayal are grave indeed. I hope we will be able to judge the heretic as soon as possible and at least partly rectify the damage he committed!
译文: 孩子，我们已经谈过正义兄弟会的家宰让·德·吉斯了。我必须再次表达对此事的痛心——他的背叛把我们推入了何等境地，又有多少人因他而丧生，这一切实在沉重。但愿我们能尽快审判这名异端，至少部分弥补他所犯下的罪过！

原文: Yes, I've heard some rumors too. The royal regiments in the whole Realm were put on the alert. Thus, I expected that also the Order of the Brotherhood of the Righteous would be asked to prepare to fight and that some further details would be passed to me. Unfortunately, in the meantime King Edward the Second was murdered and the whole situation became much more complicated because our Order is bound to military duty only to the leader of the Realm and to nobody else. Because of the current situation I don't expect somebody would tell me about current military plans...
译文: 是的，我也听到了一些传言。整个王国的王室军团都已进入戒备状态。因此，我本以为正义兄弟会也会被要求做好战斗准备，并会向我传达进一步的细节。然而不幸的是，在此期间爱德华二世国王遇刺身亡，整个局势因此变得复杂得多，因为我们修会只效忠于王国的领袖，除此之外别无他人。鉴于目前的局势，我不指望有人会把当前的军事计划告诉我……

原文: You don't have to tell me, brother. I know exactly who he was—Jean de Guise, the Seneschal of our Order, my long-time companion in arms and a true friend. Is it true?
译文: 你不必告诉我，兄弟。我清楚地知道他是谁——让·德·吉斯，我们兄弟会的家宰，我多年来的战友，也是真正的朋友。可有此事？

原文: Yes, I was sure about it. Jean de Guise, the Seneschal of our Order, my long-time companion in arms and a true friend. It was he who visited you together with me that spring. We decided to entrust you with that case of the murder of the merchant Kurth Ollmier because we knew the enemy was watching us. We couldn't afford to address the matter ourselves because we'd show the enemy that way how much we knew and where our steps were headed. For you the situation was completely different, brother. Nobody knew you; nobody could know what you plan and what were you going to do. Exactly because of that we entrusted you with the case. The only thing I don't understand is why you have come in bad faith instead of joining our forces and trying to stop the enemy whom you probably know better than me now...
译文: 是的，我确信是他。让·德·吉斯，我们正义兄弟会的家宰，我多年的老战友，真正的朋友。那个春天与我一同拜访你的人，正是他。我们决定将商人库尔特·奥尔米尔的谋杀案托付给你，因为我们知道敌人正在监视我们。我们不能亲自处理此事，否则便会向敌人暴露我们所知多少、将要走向何方。对你而言，情况则完全不同，兄弟。没有人认识你；没有人能知晓你的计划与行动。正因如此，我们才将此案交给你。我唯一不明白的是，你为何怀着恶意而来，而不是与我们合力，设法阻止那个如今你或许比我更了解的敌人……

原文: Jean de Guise introduced himself to me as the man who had visited me in the beginning of this spring and had entrusted me with the investigation of Kurth Ollmier's death. The Seneschal also told me that he believes you are a member of some plot aiming to disrupt the Realm and gave me the proof that I put forward to the Supreme Tribunal of the Inquisition. The tribunal accused you of heresy and ordered to arrest you.
译文: 让·德·吉斯向我自称，他就是初春时节拜访我、将库尔特·奥尔米尔之死的调查托付于我的那个人。这位家宰还告诉我，他相信您是一个旨在颠覆王国的阴谋的成员，并交给我证据，由我呈交宗教裁判所最高审判庭。审判庭据此指控您犯有异端罪，下令将您逮捕。

原文: What is really going on here? What of that Seneschal de Guise told me is really true?
译文: 这里究竟发生了什么？家宰德·吉斯对我说的那些话，究竟哪些是真的？

原文: What conditions do I have to meet to be appointed a Seneschal of the order, Grand Master?
译文: 我需要满足什么条件才能被任命为兄弟会的家宰，大团长？

原文: Only a Master of the Brotherhood of the Righteous may become a Seneschal of the Brotherhood, and only if he proves his utter loyalty to God and the King and completes a task that is assigned to him. Moreover, he has to prove his courage in fighting and kill more than half a thousand infernal enemies!
译文: 只有正义兄弟会的团长才能成为兄弟会的家宰，而且他必须证明自己对上帝和国王的绝对忠诚，完成指派给他的任务。此外，他还必须在战斗中证明自己的勇气，击杀五百多名地狱之敌！

原文: I would like to become a Seneschal of the Brotherhood.
译文: 我想成为兄弟会的家宰。

原文: I'll be glad to appoint you a Seneschal of the Brotherhood of the Righteous, brother. I hope you're sufficiently ready for the task I have to assign to you as a test. I won't hide that it will be a very demanding task. You'll have to clarify the murder of His Majesty King Edward II. If you manage to find his murderer and prove your exceptional bravery by killing more than half a thousand hellspawns, you'll become a Seneschal of the Order.
译文: 我很乐意任命你为正义兄弟会的家宰，兄弟。我希望你已充分准备好迎接我作为考验要指派给你的任务。我不瞒你，这将是一项极其艰巨的任务。你必须查明爱德华二世国王陛下遇害的真相。如果你能找出凶手，并以击杀五百多名地狱造物来证明你非凡的勇气，你将成为兄弟会的家宰。

原文: Fascinating! You managed to prove him guilty and force him to confess in a really admirable way! You've carried out your task, brother—and with excellence! But to be appointed a Seneschal you also have to prove your exceptional qualities in fighting. Did you kill more than half a thousand hellspawns?
译文: 了不起！你成功地证明了他的罪行，还迫使他认罪，干得实在令人钦佩！你已经完成了任务，兄弟——而且完成得出色！但要被任命为家宰，你还须证明自己在战斗中同样卓尔不群。你杀死了超过半千个地狱造物吗？

原文: Excellent! By your courage in fighting you've proven you deserve to be appointed a Seneschal of the Brotherhood of the Righteous. Congratulations, brother! Accept this item as the symbol of your new office. And herewith I give you the key of the Alvaron chapter where you're now allowed to enter!
译文: 出色！你以战场上的勇武证明了自己配得上正义兄弟会家宰之职。恭喜你，兄弟！收下此物，作为你新职衔的象征。同时，我把阿尔瓦隆分会的钥匙交给你——自今日起，你有权进入那里！

原文: You don't have to tell me, Father. I know exactly who he was—Jean de Guise, the Seneschal of our Order, my long-time companion in arms and a true friend. Is it true?
译文: 您不必告诉我，神父。我清楚地知道他是谁——让·德·吉斯，我们骑士团的家宰，我多年并肩作战的战友，一个真正的朋友。是真的吗？

原文: Yes, I was sure about it. Jean de Guise, the Seneschal of our Order, my long-time companion in arms and a true friend. It was he who visited you together with me that spring. We decided to entrust you with that case of the murder of the merchant Kurth Ollmier because we knew the enemy was watching us. We couldn't afford to address the matter ourselves because we'd show the enemy that way how much we knew and where our steps were headed. For you the situation was completely different, Father. Nobody knew you; nobody could know what you plan and what were you going to do. Exactly because of that we entrusted you with the case. The only thing I don't understand is why you have come in bad faith instead of joining our forces and trying to stop the enemy whom you probably know better than me now...
译文: 是的，我对此确信无疑。让·德·吉斯，我们兄弟会的家宰，我多年的战友，真正的朋友。那年春天，正是他与我一同前来拜访您。我们决定将商人库尔特·奥尔米尔遇害的案件托付给您，因为我们知道敌人正在监视我们。我们不能亲自处理此事——那样做只会让敌人知晓我们知道多少，以及我们的行动将走向何方。而对您来说，情况则完全不同，神父。没有人认识您；没有人能猜到您的计划和意图。正因如此，我们才将此案托付于您。我唯一不明白的是，您为何心怀敌意而来，而不是与我们联手，去阻止那个您如今恐怕比我更了解的敌人……

原文: He is the superior of the Hillbrandt chapter of the Brotherhood of the Righteous. He really is somebody. I've always thought him to be a devout man pursuing only his mission—which is to keep an eye on justice. I thought he was that sort of a pious man with a clear mind. I'd never thought he might be a heretic, knight. But these are strange times, then why strange things couldn't happen even among the knights of the Brotherhood of the Righteous, am I right? No offense, knight...
译文: 他是希尔布兰特正义兄弟会分会的上级。他确实是个大人物。我一直以为他是个虔诚的人，一心只追逐自己的使命——那就是守望正义。我以为他是那种心思澄明的虔诚之人。我从没想过他可能是异端，骑士。但如今世道离奇，正义兄弟会的骑士之中又为何不能发生离奇之事呢，我说得对吗？冒犯了，骑士……

译文: 肯特的维雷尼库斯公爵，我再一次问你：你是否认下对你的指控？你是否参与了谋害路易斯王储？你是否是黑暗势力的爪牙？说！

原文: Then you will surely answer my question correctly. Imagine you and your army are standing in front of a well fortified pagan city. The walls are full of pagan pikes and you can hear the sounds of their unholy rituals. God wishes to erase the place from His Kingdom because its existence offends his. Your army, however, is weakened by hunger and by disease of which many men are dying and the morale is failing. You're running out of supplies because the pagans attacked the supply lines on their way. Your army is not big enough to siege the city and to starve it. Moreover, your intelligence tells you that there is a big pagan army coming from another city to help their brothers and sisters. What will you do to fulfill God's will and defeat the pagans?
译文: 那么你一定能正确回答我的问题。想象你和你的军队站在一座戒备森严的异教城市面前。城墙上布满了异教的长矛，你能听到他们亵渎仪式的声音。神要将这地方从祂的王国中抹去，因为它的存在冒犯了祂。然而，你的军队正被饥荒和疾病所削弱，许多士兵正在死去，士气正在崩溃。你的补给正在耗尽，因为异教徒在途中袭击了补给线。你的军队不足以围困这座城并使其断粮。此外，你的情报显示，一支庞大的异教军队正从另一座城市赶来，援助他们的兄弟姐妹。你将如何履行神之意志并击败异教徒？

原文: No wonder you haven't, my son. It wasn't any of those heretic cults that have appeared in the Realm during last several years. The cult of Children of the New Order was a powerful group of fanatics certain Lucius gathered around himself in 9th century in the Realm. He claimed he was the Dark Prophet who came to reveal the ending of God's Kingdom in the Earth. The cult spread quickly, because the doctrine of Lucius was very captivating. Soon the heretics had many terrible crimes on their conscience, acting in the name of their ruler, the Dark Prince of Hell. But in the end the cult was destroyed and its members burned, all of them at the same time.
译文: 你未曾听闻也难怪，我的孩子。这并非近数年来王国境内出现的那些异端教派。新秩序之子教团是一个强大的狂热者团体，由卢修斯于九世纪在王国境内聚集而成。他自称暗黑先知，声称受命来揭示上帝之国在人间的终结。教团迅速蔓延，因为卢修斯的教义极具蛊惑力。不久，这些异端便以他们的统治者——地狱暗王子——之名，犯下了诸多骇人罪行。但最终，教团被摧毁，其成员尽数被焚烧，无一幸免。

原文: Yes, exactly. In addition to that all of it happened beyond the borders of our Realm—in the Lochland Empire. But nobody was really sure the cult was completely destroyed. Maybe some of its members were able to flee beyond the borders—for example here in Ultherst—and thus the doctrine of Dark Prophet Lucius has prevailed till nowadays.
译文: 不错，正是如此。不仅如此，这一切都发生在我们王国的疆界之外——在洛奇兰帝国境内。然而，并没有人真正确信该教团已被彻底消灭。或许有些成员得以逃出国境——比如流窜到此地乌尔瑟斯特——从而使暗黑先知卢修斯的教义延续至今。

原文: Of course, I'm all right! Why do you think I'm not? And why do you care about my health?
译文: 当然，我很好！你为什么觉得我不好？你又为什么关心我的健康？

原文: Do you think it's a sin to care about a neighbor's health, Father?
译文: 神父，你认为关心邻人的健康是一种罪过吗？

原文: Oh... no, I'm sorry, of course it's not. Everybody says I look ill. But not everybody's been blessed with an excellent health.
译文: 哦……不，对不起，当然不是。人人都说我看上去病恹恹的。但不是每个人都能蒙赐一副好体魄的。

原文: It may be just my impression but you seem to react too overtly. Does it bother you to speak about your health? Why?
译文: 可能只是我的错觉，但你的反应似乎过于激烈了。谈论你的健康让你不舒服吗？为什么？

原文: It doesn't bother me to talk about it. It's just that everybody is always asking me about my health. I'm tired of explaining everybody that some people have simply not been blessed with an excellent health.
译文: 谈论这个我并不介意。只是每个人总是来问我身体怎么样。我厌倦了向所有人解释，有些人就是没能蒙赐一副好体魄。

原文: My health is in God's hands as well as my life! So stop asking your stupid questions!
译文: 我的健康与生命都掌握在上帝手中！别再问你那些愚蠢的问题了！

原文: What do you want, son. Did you come to ask inappropriate questions about my health?
译文: 你想要什么，孩子。你是来问些关于我健康状况的不当问题吗？

原文: Do you think it's a sin to care about a neighbor's health, brother?
译文: 你认为关心邻人的健康是一种罪吗，兄弟？

原文: The Cult of the Children of the New Order? That name really does ring a bell with me. If I remember correctly, it was a heretic cult formed and then acting in the Empire during the Hundred Years War. It was just another group of demoniacs—quite wide spread in those times. People turned to demon worshipping during times of the worst indigence—I'd say it resembled the situation in the Realm nowadays. However, the cult was nothing like a league of poor men preaching that everybody can do whatever he wanted. The cult was founded by a certain Lucius who called himself the Dark Prophet and heralded to his followers that the New Order will come and its children will rule the world—by the means of releasing Satan from his imprisonment.
译文: 新秩序之子教团？这个名字我确实有些印象。如果我没记错的话，那是百年战争期间在帝国境内形成并活动的一个异端教派。它不过是又一个崇拜恶魔的团体——在那个时代相当普遍。当人们陷入最深重的困顿时，便会转向恶魔崇拜——我认为如今王国的处境与之相似。然而，这个教派绝非一群宣扬"人人皆可为所欲为"的穷苦之人的联盟。教派由一个自称暗黑先知的卢修斯所创立，他向追随者宣称新秩序即将降临，其子民将统治世界——方式便是将撒旦从囚禁中释放出来。

原文: I like the legend of the Coliseum the most, knight. Do you know what the Coliseum was? It was such a large circular theatre standing in the middle of Galibornium when this country was still ruled by pagans. But there were no stage plays acted there, instead it was a place where brave heroes and warriors fought one against another. Fought to the death. In the middle there was no stage but a ring where the fights took place. People went there to see all those brave heroes fighting. Although my father said the Coliseum was firstly some sort of gallows and only later it became the entertainment for warriors, but I don't know anything about that. In any case those fights—they were called gladiatorial, but I don't know why—they were very popular and everyone went to see them. People say there used to be fights lasting several days, whole battles they were, and the victors enjoyed the glory and admiration worthy of an emperor. Ah, those were great times!
译文: 我最喜欢斗兽场的传说，骑士。你知道斗兽场是什么吗？当这个国家还被异教徒统治之时，加利博尼姆城中央矗立着一座巨大的圆形剧场。但那里从不上演舞台剧，相反，那是勇敢的英雄和战士互相厮杀的场所，战斗至死。场地中央没有舞台，只有一处用于厮杀的角斗场。人们去那里观看所有那些勇敢英雄的搏斗。虽然我父亲说斗兽场最初是某种绞刑架，后来才变成战士们的消遣，但我对此一无所知。无论如何，那些战斗——它们被称为角斗，但我不知道为什么——极为风行，人人都去观看。据说曾有持续数日的战斗，简直就是整场战役，胜利者享有堪比帝王的荣耀与敬仰。啊，那真是伟大的时代！

原文: Don't interrupt me, son. The letter continues to say there's a suspicion Judge Vallarian concocted the invocation of the Fallen Angel Arthamon who is to enter this world with armies of orcs called forth from the Accursed Depths. And what's worse, along with Diocesan Bishop Quentinus you started to suspect that Judge Vallarian could be a member of the heretical Cult of the Children of the New Order.
译文: 别打断我，孩子。信中接着说，有人怀疑瓦拉里安法官策划了召唤堕天使阿尔萨蒙的仪式，那堕天使将率兽人大军自受诅深渊涌入这个世界。更糟糕的是，你与教区的昆提努斯主教开始怀疑，瓦拉里安法官可能是异端新秩序之子教团的成员。

原文: The legend has it that in the year 965 the dark prophet Lucius foretold the end of the God's Earthly kingdom and the advent of the Dark prince, the bloody angel of revenge, who should sit on the Throne of Heaven instead of God himself. The prophecy was based on the wording of the Holy Scriptures, same as many other similar predictions, concretely on the Revelations of Saint Ezekiel—Apocalypse.
译文: 据传，965年，暗黑先知卢修斯预言了神的尘世王国的终结，以及黑暗君王的降临——那嗜血的复仇天使将取代神本人，登上天堂王座。这则预言以圣典的经文为依据，与众多类似的预言如出一辙，具体而言，便是依据《圣以西结启示录》——即《启示录》。

原文: I'm not surprised in any way by Master Dieter von Gelbendiel saying something like that, my son. One may quite easily doubt the moral qualities of that man. As a knight of the Brotherhood of the Righteous—which is, by the way, a friary order—he should honor all virtues of the clergy, but he decidedly doesn't do so. He's a utilitarian and a careerist, and it led him to intriguing and to trying to get the office of the Seneschal. I've been watching him for years. That's why I'm not surprised he tries to defame me. But I didn't suspect he would go so far in his arrogance as to maintain I plotted some unholy rites!
译文: 对于迪特尔·冯·盖尔本迪尔大人说出这样的话，我丝毫不感到意外，我的孩子。那个人的道德品质实在不难令人怀疑。作为正义兄弟会的骑士——顺便说一句，那是一个托钵修士会——他本应恪守神职人员的一切美德，但他显然没有做到。他是个功利之徒、野心之辈，这使他热衷于阴谋钻营，觊觎家宰之位。我观察他已有多年。正因如此，他企图诽谤我并不令我意外。但我未曾料到他狂妄到如此地步，竟敢宣称我在密谋某种亵渎神圣的仪式！

原文: Really? That's bad news. Up till now I thought the cult was utterly destroyed in former times. They were demoniacs, worshippers of Satan, gathered in the second half of the tenth century by a certain Lucius who declared himself a Dark Prophet. This Lucius reputedly foretold the end of the God's Earthly Kingdom and the freeing of Satan from his thousand years prison—as the Holy Scriptures tell us in the Apocalypse of Saint Ezekiel.
译文: 当真？这可不是好消息。在此之前，我还以为这个教团早已在往昔被彻底摧毁。他们是恶魔的信徒、撒旦的崇拜者，于十世纪下半叶被一个自称暗黑先知的卢修斯聚集起来。据说这个卢修斯预言了神的尘世王国的终结，以及撒旦挣脱千年囚禁的时刻——正如圣典中圣以西结启示录所记载的那样。

原文: No, surely it isn't, my dear son. I'd like to tell you all I know about the Children of the New Order. It just startled me you're asking about the cult that was destroyed so long ago. But let's speak in an ordered way. They were demoniacs, worshippers of Satan, gathered in the second half of the tenth century by a certain Lucius who declared himself a Dark Prophet. This Lucius reputedly foretold the end of the God's Earthly Kingdom and the freeing of Satan from his thousand years prison—as the Holy Scriptures tell us in the Apocalypse of Saint Ezekiel.
译文: 不，当然没有，我亲爱的孩子。我愿意把我所知道的关于新秩序之子的一切都告诉你。只是你问起这个早已被摧毁的教团，让我吃了一惊。不过，我们还是按顺序来说。他们是恶魔的信徒、撒旦的崇拜者，于十世纪下半叶被一个自称暗黑先知的卢修斯聚集起来。据说这个卢修斯预言了神的尘世王国的终结，以及撒旦挣脱千年囚禁的时刻——正如圣典中圣以西结启示录所记载的那样。

原文: Certainly. As I've already said it was a cult of demoniacs, presumably established in the second half of the tenth century by a certain Lucius who declared himself to be a Dark Prophet. This Lucius reputedly foretold the end of the God's Earthly Kingdom and the freeing of Satan from his thousand years prison—as the Holy Scriptures tell us in the Apocalypse of the Saint Ezekiel. As you can see, it wasn't any breakthrough prophecy, because it stemmed from the notorious passage of the Holy Scriptures. Likewise the teachings of Lucius didn't differ much from the teachings of other heretical sects of that era—it ran upon the saying carpe diem. That means—do what you want, there's neither Heaven nor God, and even if it existed it wouldn't matter because in a couple of years the world would become a part of Hell. And who collaborates with hellspawns will rule over enslaved souls of the faithful. The Children of the New Order behaved roughly in that way and believed that when the end of the world comes and Satan sits on the throne of Heaven and Earth, they all would have a hell of a good time.
译文: 当然。正如我此前所说，这是一个恶魔崇拜的教团，大约由十世纪下半叶一个自称暗黑先知的卢修斯所创立。据说这个卢修斯预言了神的尘世王国的终结，以及撒旦从千年囚禁中被释放——正如圣典在圣以西结的启示录中所告诉我们的。你看，这算不上什么惊世预言，因为它不过源自圣典中那段臭名昭著的经文。同样，卢修斯的教义与当时其他异端教派的教义也相差无几——其核心不过是那句格言"及时行乐"。也就是说——想做什么就做什么，既没有天堂也没有上帝；即便二者存在也无关紧要，因为再过几年世界就会成为地狱的一部分。而与地狱造物勾结之人，将统治信众被奴役的灵魂。新秩序之子的所作所为大致如此，他们相信当世界末日降临、撒旦登上天堂王座与大地王座之时，他们都能好好快活一场。

原文: Canis, qui sanctus est, numquam delirat.
译文: 圣犬从不胡言乱语。

原文: Have you heard the legend about the treasure of Baron Decard of Longhorn? It's a very gloomy tale, although it concerns a magic treasure. Baron Decard of Longhorn was a famous collector of all sorts of relics and artifacts, mostly from ages long past. But later on his collector's zeal started to become an obsession and the Baron wanted more and more. So he sold himself to dark powers and with their help he started to steal, deceive, rob and even to murder to get possession of some or other rare items.
译文: 你听说过朗霍恩的德卡德男爵宝藏的传说吗？那是一个阴郁的故事，尽管它牵涉一件魔法宝藏。朗霍恩的德卡德男爵是一位著名的收藏家，搜罗各类圣物与古器，大多来自久远的年代。然而后来，他的收藏之癖渐渐沦为痴迷，男爵的欲望愈发膨胀。于是他将自己出卖给黑暗势力，在其协助下开始偷窃、欺骗、劫掠，甚至为夺取某件珍稀之物而杀人。

原文: Show me that root, sir... Oh my! It's a Radix Diaboli root, people call it Devil's Root! It's very rare and very magic. I can make you a rather powerful power-up potion of it.
译文: 把那根给我看看，大人……哎呀！这是魔鬼之根，人们管它叫魔鬼之根！它极其稀有，魔力非凡。我可以用它给您配一瓶效力强劲的强化药剂。

原文: It is Master Edmond d'Arvias, the superior of the Hillbrandt Chapter of the Brotherhood of the Righteous. Yes, you've heard right. I know that it sounds crazy, nevertheless it seems beyond doubt that he was the one who summoned the orcs and other hellspawns and who's using them to pursue his shameful goals which he exchanged for his holy mission and protection of divine order he swore to uphold in his monastic oath. As you can see, it's a rather delicate matter that will test your real aims—either you'll try to enforce justice or your actual intentions will come out.
译文: 正是埃德蒙·达尔维亚斯大师，希尔布兰特正义兄弟会分会的负责人。是的，你没听错。我知道这听起来近乎疯狂，但似乎已无可置疑——召唤兽人和其他地狱造物的正是他，而他正利用它们追逐自己可耻的目标；为此，他用自己的神圣使命与对神圣秩序的守护作了交换——那是他在修道誓言中发誓要捍卫的职责。如你所见，这是一件颇为棘手的事，将考验你真正的意图——要么你会努力伸张正义，要么你的真实用心将暴露无遗。

原文: Of course you may ask, my son. After all it's the task I'm going to entrust to you. Listen carefully and don't let yourself be confused. The perpetrator is no one less important than Master Edmond d'Arvias, the superior of the Hillbrandt Chapter of the Brotherhood of the Righteous. Yes, I know that it sounds crazy, nevertheless it seems beyond doubt that he was the one who summoned the orcs and other hellspawns and who's using them to pursue his shameful goals which he exchanged for his holy mission and protection of divine order he swore to uphold in his monastic oath.
译文: 当然可以问，我的孩子。毕竟这正是我要托付给你的任务。仔细听好，不要被弄糊涂了。犯下此事的正是埃德蒙·达尔维亚斯大师——希尔布兰特正义兄弟会分会的负责人。是的，我知道这听上去匪夷所思，但毫无疑问，召唤兽人及其他地狱造物的正是他，他利用它们来追逐可耻的目标——为了这些目标，他背弃了自己在修道誓约中誓言要践行的神圣使命和对神圣秩序的守护。

原文: It is Master Edmond d'Arvias, the superior of the Hillbrandt Chapter of the Brotherhood of the Righteous. Yes, you've heard well. I know that it sounds crazy, nevertheless it seems beyond doubt that he was the one who summoned the orcs and other hellspawns and who's using them to pursue his shameful goals which he exchanged for his holy mission and protection of divine order, which he swore to uphold in his monastic oath. As you can see, it's a rather delicate matter.
译文: 就是埃德蒙·达尔维亚斯大师，希尔布兰特正义兄弟会分会的负责人。是的，你没听错。我知道这听起来很疯狂，然而毋庸置疑，正是他召唤了兽人和其他地狱造物，并利用它们去追逐他那可耻的目标——他抛弃了神圣使命与神圣秩序的守护职责，而那正是他在修道誓言中发誓要捍卫的一切。正如你所见，这是一件相当棘手的事情。

原文: I understand. In that case, I'll let you go, Sir Knight, even though I'll never become the Seneschal of the Brotherhood of Righteous. And I hope God will punish you and you'll die in the battle...
译文: 我明白了。那样的话，我将放你走，骑士阁下，尽管我永远也当不上正义兄弟会的家宰。我希望神会惩罚你，让你战死沙场……

原文: The Chalice of Metamorphosis? No, it doesn't ring the bell. What should it be?
译文: 变形圣杯？听起来没什么印象。那是什么东西？

原文: There are many hellspawns lurking around Hillbrandt, knight. This spring the orcs came out from the entrails of the Moonshine Mountains and killed everybody both in the iron mines and in the miners' village Asherbalt. Since that time, thick black smoke rises to the sky in the mountains, so I'm sure—because I'm the blacksmith—they process iron ore there. God knows what do they need it for. If there were people in the mountains, I'd say they want to equip an army. But the orcs are not people, so it's hard to say what devilment are they preparing. I fear we'll get to know soon anyway.
译文: 希尔布兰特附近潜伏着许多地狱造物，骑士。今年春天，兽人从月光山脉的腹地杀了出来，把铁矿和矿工村阿舍巴尔特的人全部杀光。从那以后，山中浓黑的烟柱直冲天际，所以我敢肯定——因为我是铁匠——他们在那里冶炼铁矿石。上帝才知道他们要这东西做什么。如果山里住的是人，我会说他们想装备一支军队。但兽人不是人，所以很难说他们在酝酿什么阴谋。恐怕我们很快就会知道了。

原文: There are many hellspawns lurking around Hillbrandt, noble sir. This spring the orcs came out from the entrails of the Moonshine Mountains and killed everybody both in the iron mines and in the miners' village Asherbalt. Since that time, thick black smoke rises to the sky in the mountains, so I'm sure—because I'm the blacksmith—they process iron ore there. God knows what do they need it for. If there were people in the mountains, I'd say they want to equip an army. But the orcs are not people, so it's hard to say what devilment are they preparing. I fear we'll get to know soon anyway.
译文: 希尔布兰特周遭潜伏着许多地狱造物，尊贵的老爷。今年春天，兽人从月光山脉的腹地钻了出来，把铁矿和矿工村阿舍巴尔特的人杀了个精光。自那以后，山中浓黑的烟柱直冲天际，所以我敢肯定——因为我就是铁匠——他们在那儿冶炼铁矿石。天知道他们要这东西做什么。若山里住的是人，我会说他们想装备一支军队。可兽人不是人，所以说不准他们在酝酿什么鬼把戏。恐怕我们很快就会知道了。

原文: Unbelievable! Are you telling me that Bishop Herbertius rose from his grave? That's infernal! And as if it was not enough, according to your words priest Romius was commanded by that spawn of darkness to steal the monstrance. A priest of the Holy Mother Church enthralled by infernal powers... I find it hard to believe, nevertheless I can't doubt your words, sir. It is obvious that heresy has rooted itself deep in this town—it has infected even the ranks of the Church. Nevertheless I am glad to say that you've completed your task with excellence! The monstrance is back and the perpetrator is revealed. That means I'm free to bestow the title of Baron of Asherbalt upon you. That is if you have 5,000 gp. to pay for the entry into the Gold Book of the Realm...
译文: 难以置信！你是说赫伯提乌斯主教从坟墓中复活了？这简直是地狱之灾！更糟的是，照你所言，牧师罗米乌斯竟是受那黑暗孽种的驱使才盗走了圣体光。一位圣母教会的牧师竟被地狱之力所蛊惑……我实在难以置信，然而阁下，我无法怀疑你的话。异端显然已在这座城镇深深扎根——甚至侵蚀了教会内部。不过我仍欣慰地说，你出色地完成了任务！圣体光已经归位，元凶也已查明。这意味着我得以将艾舍巴尔特男爵的头衔授予你——前提是你有五千金币支付载入王国金册的费用……

原文: You're infinitely lucky, innkeeper. I've coincidentally gained possession of several bottles of that wine. Here they are.
译文: 你真是交了天大的好运，旅店老板。我恰好弄到了几瓶那酒。拿去吧。

原文: I know about Father Frederick more than anyone else, son. Why, he was my longtime tutor and mentor! His name will stay engraved in my memory as long as I live. It was he who led me to the bosom of the Holy Mother Church and it was he who at the end of his life greatly encouraged me to become a member of the Holy Office. Father Frederick was a very wise man. He traveled a lot. He visited the Empire and dwelt at the Papal Court. He traveled through all the faithful realms of Kalmariland and talked with their highest church officials. According to his words—and I definitely don't doubt them—he visited even the Holy Grave of the First Prophet in Jevaran and bowed before his remains. He was the most educated and the most wise man I've ever met. And moreover he was as modest as every priest should be.
译文: 孩子，没有人比我更了解弗雷德里克神父。他可是我多年的导师与引路人！只要我一息尚存，他的名字便会镌刻在我的记忆之中。正是他引领我投入圣母教会的怀抱，也是他在生命尽头极力鼓励我加入圣务院。弗雷德里克神父是一位极具智慧的人。他游历甚广，曾到访帝国，并在教皇宫廷居住。他走遍了卡尔马里兰所有虔诚的国度，与各地最高的教会官员交谈。据他所说——我绝不会怀疑——他甚至亲赴杰瓦兰的先知圣墓，向第一先知的遗骸俯首致敬。他是我所见过学识最渊博、也最有智慧的人。而且，他如每一位牧师应有的那样谦逊。

原文: The Cult of the Children of the New Order? I've heard about it, of course. It's one of the historically important cases of the growth of a demonic sect and of the fight against it. It all happened in the second half of the 9th century of the Empire. It was at the end of the Hundred Years War, when the whole faithful world was burdened with bloody wars and despair was breaking human hearts like deadwood. At that time a certain Lucius, who deemed himself as a Dark Prophet, preached the end of the God's earthly kingdom and the freeing of Satan from his thousand years prison. With this teaching, that denied the Holy Mother Church, the Holy Scriptures and God himself, and urged the indecent and depraved life, he gathered around him a numerous group containing even the members of the imperial court. The Papal Holy Office was hard put to destroy the cult, but eventually it succeeded and during great proceedings it sentenced all the members of the cult—including Lucius himself—to be burned to death. As far as I know there have been no mention of the cult since then. Why are you asking?
译文: 新秩序之子教团？我当然听说过。这是邪教兴起及其被铲除这一历史上重要案例之一。事情发生在帝国九世纪下半叶。那正值百年战争末期，整个信仰世界被血腥战争重压，绝望如枯木般击碎人类的心灵。当时有一个自称暗黑先知的卢修斯，宣扬神的尘世王国的终结，以及撒旦从千年囚禁中被释放。凭借这一否定圣母教会、圣典乃至上帝本人、并鼓吹淫乱堕落生活的教义，他聚拢了一大批追随者，其中甚至包括帝国宫廷的成员。教皇圣务院费尽周折才摧毁了这一教团，但最终成功了，在一场大审判中，教团全体成员——包括卢修斯本人——被判处火刑。据我所知，此后再未有关于该教团的记载。你为何问起这个？

原文: I know about Father Frederick more than anyone else, brother. Why, he was my longtime tutor and mentor! His name will stay engraved in my memory as long as I live. It was he who led me to the bosom of the Holy Mother Church and it was he who at the end of his life greatly encouraged me to become a member of the Holy Office. Father Frederick was a very wise man. He traveled a lot. He visited the Empire and dwelt at the Papal Court. He traveled through all the faithful realms of Kalmariland and talked with their highest church officials. According to his words—and I definitely don't doubt them—he visited even the Holy Grave of the First Prophet in Jevaran and bowed before his remains. He was the most educated and the most wise man I've ever met. And moreover he was as modest as every priest should be.
译文: 我比任何人都了解弗雷德里克神父，兄弟。他可是我多年的导师与引路人！他的名字将铭刻在我的记忆中，直至我生命的尽头。正是他引领我走进圣母教会的怀抱，也正是他在生命的最后岁月里，极力鼓励我成为圣务院的一员。弗雷德里克神父是一位极具智慧的人。他游历甚广。他曾到访帝国，并在教皇宫廷居住。他走遍了卡尔马里兰所有虔诚的领地，与各地最高教会官员交谈。据他所说——我绝不会怀疑他的话——他甚至曾前往杰瓦兰的先知圣墓，向第一先知的遗骸躬身致敬。他是我所见过最有学识、最有智慧的人。而且，他如每一位牧师应有的那般谦逊。

原文: I saw priest Romius and I'm worried about his health. Has he come to you for an advice lately?
译文: 我见过罗米乌斯神父，我很担心他的健康状况。他最近来找过你寻求建议吗？

原文: Priest Romius hasn't asked me for any advice about his health recently, knight. But to tell the truth I too noticed him not looking good lately. He's very pale, queasy and he seems tired all the time. As if he had anemia. But that's apparently nonsense because he was completely healthy not long ago.
译文: 罗米乌斯神父最近没有向我寻求过任何关于健康的建议，骑士。但说实话，我也注意到他近来气色不佳。他面色苍白，总觉恶心，而且似乎一直很疲倦。像是贫血的症状。但这显然是胡说，因为他不久前还完全健康。

原文: Priest Romius hasn't asked me for any advice about his health recently, Father. But to tell the truth I too noticed him not looking good lately. He's very pale, queasy and he seems tired all the time. As if he had anemia. But that's apparently nonsense because he was completely healthy not long ago.
译文: 罗米乌斯神父最近没有就他的健康向我请教过什么，神父。但说实话，我也注意到他近来气色不佳。他脸色苍白、恶心想吐，似乎无时不刻都很疲惫。像是得了贫血。但这显然是胡说，因为不久前他还完全健康。

原文: Priest Romius hasn't asked me for any advice about his health recently, noble sir. But to tell the truth I too noticed him not looking good lately. He's very pale, queasy and he seems tired all the time. As if he had anemia. But that's apparently nonsense because he was completely healthy not long ago.
译文: 罗米乌斯神父最近没有向我问过他的健康状况，高贵的先生。但说实话，我也注意到他最近气色不好。他脸色苍白，反胃，而且似乎总是很疲倦。像是得了贫血。但这显然是胡说，因为他不久前还完全健康。

原文: This is Edmond d'Arvias's letter to Bishop Trevorius in Glatzburg. It reads:\\n\\nDear friend,\\nI sincerely hope you receive this letter in kind health and fair circumstance, despite the evils plaguing us all. I would trouble you, Trevorius, to aid the bearer of this letter with an investigation of the utmost importance. Though I tremble to write the words which follow, I fear even more your disbelieving them, old friend. There has been a conspiracy in Hillbrandt to invoke the fallen angel, Arthamon—a conspiracy, I fear, which has likely succeeded. What makes the case all the more troubling is that Bishop Vallarian, who you know well from the Inquisitorial Curia of Glatzburg, has been convicted of the crime.\\nAs you can see, this is no petty case of hearsay heresy. Though the betrayal of an inquisitorial judge frightens me to no end, Trevorius, certain truths which have come to light bring a chill to my very soul. Though it may only be the rambling of a doomed man, Judge Vallarian left a warning for the bearer of this letter; the Children of the New Order, of which you certainly know more than I, walk the Earth again.\\nI would ask you to afford the bearer of this letter all possible assistance with his investigation, and to help him discover the truth behind Judge Vallarian’s betrayal. I fear more than my peace of mind hangs in the balance, old friend.\\nEver Yours, Edmond
译文:
这是埃德蒙·达尔维亚斯在格拉茨堡写下的致特雷维里乌斯主教的信。信上写道：

亲爱的朋友，
尽管邪恶正困扰着我们所有人，我仍由衷希望你收到此信时身心康健、境遇顺遂。我要劳烦你，特雷维里乌斯，协助持信人进行一项至关重要的调查。写下接下来这些字句时我双手颤抖，老朋友，但我更害怕的是你不肯相信。希尔布兰特发生了一起召唤堕落天使阿尔萨蒙的阴谋——我担心，这阴谋恐怕已经得逞。更令此案棘手的是，你在格拉茨堡宗教裁判庭便熟知的瓦拉里安主教，已被判定犯下此罪。
如你所见，这绝非一桩道听途说的异端小事。尽管一名宗教裁判法官的背叛已让我恐惧万分，特雷维里乌斯，某些浮出水面的真相更令我的灵魂发寒。纵然这可能只是一个将死之人的胡言乱语，瓦拉里安法官还是给持信人留下了一句警告：新秩序之子——关于他们你自然比我更清楚——已重临世间。
我恳请你给予持信人一切可能的协助，帮助他查明瓦拉里安法官背叛背后的真相。老朋友，悬于一线的，远不止我一人的安宁。
永远属于你的，埃德蒙

原文: This is the severed head of Henrey de Montreaux, ex-paladin of the Brotherhood of the Righteous. Brother Henrey walked a path from whence he could never return; a path that many before him have walked and—God forgive us—many more will walk after his passing. The righteous should hang their heads in prayer to see such a man fall. He could have been so much more, had he devoted himself to the ideals of worldly justice and our Lord God Almighty’s peace.
译文: 这是正义兄弟会前圣骑士亨利·德·蒙特罗被斩下的首级。亨利兄弟走上了一条无法回头的路；在他之前已有许多人走上了这条路，而在他身后——愿上帝宽恕我们——还会有更多人重蹈覆辙。义人们当垂首祈祷，目睹如此之人堕落。倘若他献身于世间正义的理想与我主全能的上帝的安宁，他本可以成就更多。

原文: Potions of Cure Disease, under the correct circumstances, can cure any disease currently affecting the imbiber. The quality of the potion determines the strength of the cure—certain diseases can only be cured by the strongest Potions of Cure Disease. These potions are created by mixing potions of Constitution and Healing.
译文: 治愈疾病药水在恰当的条件下，能治愈当前影响饮用者的任何疾病。药水的品质决定治愈的效力——某些疾病唯有最强效的治愈疾病药水方能根除。这种药水由体质药水和治疗药水调制而成。

原文: A single glance at this abominable volume would likely drive a normal man insane. The book itself is bound in human flesh, and painted with scenes of the most unimaginable depravity. The scenes, painted in blood which never dries, swirl and slither across the book’s ghastly, writhing cover. If what I know of the book is true, it was written in the year 850 by the Dark Prophet, Lucius, founder of the Children of New Order. Judging from the living script, it seems to detail the rise of the fallen angels, Arthamon, Baphomet and Cerdie.\\n\\nLucius describes the rites for summoning the fallen angels in the most thorough... and sickening terms. His descriptions and instructions as to how the Children should go about committing the atrocities needed to bring Hell to Earth are terrifying, in a word. This Dark Prophet, this Lucius, could never have been a man of flesh and blood like me. The implications of that possibility are... are too frightening to even consider.\\n\\nLord protect me, there’s more. Apparently, one of the Children will be “Marked by the Beast,” and it will be his or her duty to perform the ritual necessary to bring Hell to our world:\\n\\n”Blessed are the chosen, the vessels of corruption! Carry on your person, marked champion, this tome, for through it are channeled the powers which will open the way. To open the gates of Hell, you must be willing to sacrifice. First, you must make an offering of the blood of your brow, breast, and loins. When the unclean blood has mixed at your feet, use it as ink to inscribe the drawn mark upon the gateway. Your mortal form will be consumed, for great and powerful are the fires of Hell, but your spirit will live forever among the princes of the damned, and your sacrifice will bring about the end of God’s feeble, flawed creation.”\\n\\nMay the angels forgive me for what I have read, and may God shed his mercy over me. I must end this, once and for all.
译文:
仅凭一瞥，这本可憎之书便足以令常人发疯。书本身以人类的皮肤装订，封面绘满了难以想象的堕落场景。那些场景用永不干涸的鲜血绘成，在书封可怖而蠕动的表面上盘旋滑行。若我所知属实，此书成于850年，作者是暗黑先知卢修斯——新秩序之子的创立者。从那些活生生的文字来看，书中详述了堕落天使阿尔萨蒙、巴弗灭与塞尔迪的崛起。

卢修斯以最详尽……也最令人作呕的笔触，描述了召唤堕落天使的仪式。他关于新秩序之子应如何犯下那些罪行、以将地狱带入人间的描述与指示，简而言之，令人胆寒。这位暗黑先知，这个卢修斯，绝不可能是像我这样的血肉之躯。那种可能性所隐含的意味……实在太可怕，甚至不敢去想。

主啊，护佑我，后面还有。据记载，新秩序之子中有一人将"被兽标记"，由他或她来履行仪式，将地狱带入我们的世界：

"蒙福的是被拣选者，腐化的器皿！背负这卷圣典吧，被标记的勇士，因为正是通过它，通往彼方的力量得以传导。欲开启地狱之门，你必须甘愿献祭。首先，你须以额间、胸前与腰腹之血作为祭品。当污秽之血在你脚下交融，便以它为墨，将画好的印记刻于门扉之上。你的肉身将被吞噬，因地狱之火强大而炽烈；但你的灵魂将与被诅咒的诸王永存，而你的牺牲将终结上帝那脆弱而残缺的造物。"

愿天使宽恕我所读到的一切，愿上帝将怜悯倾注于我。我必须终结这一切，一劳永逸。

原文: Adanabius of Hognar, the Seeking Mystic, was made rather infamous for hisDiquisitiones Magicae, which the Church originally considered heretical due to Adanabius’s “devaluation” of miracles. Nevertheless the book was deemed acceptable by the Adavian Council in 1008 as one of the paths of discovering Divine truth.\\n\\The text describes, in Adanabius’s own words, how angels and other beings touched by the Lord’s grace are capable of performing miracles – not because they are blessed, but because they possess the faith and temperament required to perform the casting of certain “spells” which manifest themselves in the form of the Divine Presence, which is in turn the physical manifestation of the Holy Ghost. While accepted as truth, this text directly contradicts previous Church dogma, which states that only the Lord God Almighty is capable of performing miracles. The Church has yet to provide a feasible response to this contradiction of truths.
译文: 霍格纳尔的阿达纳比乌斯，探索神秘学家，因他的《魔法探究》而颇为臭名昭著——由于阿达纳比乌斯对神迹的“贬值”，教会最初认为此书属于异端。然而在1008年，该书被阿达维安会议认可为探寻神圣真理的路径之一。\\n\\T这段文字以阿达纳比乌斯自己的话，描述了天使及其他蒙受主之恩典的存在为何能够施行神迹——并非因为他们受了祝福，而是因为他们拥有施展某些“法术”所必需的信仰与心性；这些法术以神圣临在的形式显现，而神圣临在正是圣灵的物质显现。这段文字虽被接受为真理，却直接与教会先前的教义相抵触——该教义宣称，唯有主、全能的上帝才能施行神迹。对于这一真理之间的矛盾，教会至今未能给出一个站得住脚的回应。

原文: The Monstrance of St. Orthenius is one of the most valuable holy relics in all of Utherst, having been blessed by Orthenius himself in the year 221. It was brought to Hillbrandt in 339 by Father Albertinus, the first Bishop of Hillbrandt, and soon became the most valued treasure of the newly-formed diocese. According to local legends, the Monstrance is imbued with tremendous power which prevents the town of Hillbrandt from falling so long as the relic rests within her walls. It mysteriously vanished in the spring of 1223, sending the small mountain village into a bit of a panic. With good reason, no less, as the village was shortly thereafter attacked by a warband of orcs. I fear no one in Hillbrandt will rest easy until I return the artifact to the church’s care. Though,I can’t help but to imagine the power of a single man, utterly unconquerable while in the possession of a lone relic. The implications are tempting... and utterly corrupting.
译文: 圣奥塞尼乌斯圣体光是整个乌尔瑟斯特最珍贵的圣物之一，曾于221年由奥塞尼乌斯本人亲自祝圣。339年，希尔布兰特首任主教阿尔贝提努斯神父将其带到希尔布兰特，它很快便成为新设教区最为珍视的宝物。据当地传说，圣体光蕴含着巨大的力量，只要圣物仍在城中，希尔布兰特便不会陷落。它于1223年春天神秘失踪，令这座小山村一时陷入恐慌——而且确有理由恐慌，因为不久之后村庄便遭一队兽人袭击。在圣体光归还教会之前，恐怕希尔布兰特无人能安枕无忧。不过，我忍不住想象：一个凡人若独占这件圣物，将是何等不可战胜。这样的前景……实在诱人，也实在令人堕落。

原文: The Libre Necronomicon is a collection of Old Lateran texts dealing with death, the afterlife, demons and the “netherworld.” There are several rites and incantations detailed within, most dealing with the summoning of lesser demons and the preparation of heretical masses. One spell, however, deals with the summoning of dead spirits. The text itself is rather gruesome...\\n\\nLet he who fears not the gaze of death look upon these words and marvel. To perform this particular rite, one must be in possession of the skull of the deceased in question and the Necklace of Death, an artifact which must have been crafted beyond the sight of God consisting of bits of bone and rotten flesh. Once the necklace is fitted over the incanter’s neck and the skull of the deceased is taken in hand, the necromancer must sing the litany penned below at the site of the deceased’s fall. When, and only when, this rite has been completed will the dead heed the necromancer’s call and give the answers once hidden by the shroud of death.
译文: 死灵之书是一部古拉特兰语文本的合集，内容涉及死亡、来世、恶魔与"冥界"。书中详述了数种仪式与咒文，大多涉及召唤低阶恶魔与筹备异端弥撒。然而，其中一则法术关乎召唤亡者之灵。原文本身颇为骇人……\\n\\n凡不惧死亡之凝视者，可观此文字而惊叹。欲行此仪式，须持有所涉死者之颅骨与死亡项链——此物必是在神目不及之处以碎骨与腐肉制成。待项链套于吟咒者颈间、死者颅骨握于手中，死灵法师须在死者殒命之地吟唱下方所录的连祷。唯有此仪式彻底完成，亡者方会应允死灵法师的召唤，吐露曾被死之帷幕掩藏的答案。

原文: This is the fresh corpse of what appears to have once been a young woman.  I found her remains in the dungeon beneath the Arch Bishop’s palace, where a heretical mass most likely took place. At most, the death occurred hours ago. Rigor Mortis has barely taken hold of her limbs, and the contortion of her facial muscles indicates that her death was utterly gruesome. The abdominal cavity is prolapsed and the womb is shredded... something appears to have hatched from within her body. God forgive me, I pray I never have to write those words ever again.
译文: 这是一具新鲜的尸体，看来生前是一位年轻女子。我在大主教宫殿下方的地牢中发现了她的遗骸，那里极可能发生过一场异端弥撒。死亡至多发生在数小时前。尸僵才刚刚侵袭她的四肢，面部肌肉的扭曲表明她的死状极其骇人。腹腔已经脱垂，子宫被撕得粉碎……有什么东西似乎从她体内孵化而出。上帝宽恕我，我祈求永远不必再写下这些字句。

原文: Ahalaar's Will. The name alone was enough to strike fear into the hearts of men returning from the Holy Wars, and with good reason.\\n\\nThe Jad-Habaal have long been famous for their peculiar fighting style. Making great use of curved swords and cloth armor, the Jad-Habaal are perhaps most famous for their mounted archers; fearless warriors wielding short bows who ride wild desert stallions into battle. Of these warriors, none was more feared than Shaik Omhar Bhutaar ad Kandahaar, a noble of the third era known to his foes only as “Dead Shot.” With his bow, Ahalaar’s Will, which was said to be able to strike a faithless man dead in the eye from over two-hundred meters away, he laid waste to his enemies of his heathen god.\\n\\nThe bow’s creation was commissioned for use in the Holy War declared in 385 by King Rafmaanii the Wise of Kandahaar. The relic fell into the hands of the faithful during the Second Crusade by members of the Order of the Holy Cross, who looted it from the corpse of a nameless pagan general. How that general came to possess such a marvelous weapon, none would ever learn, but the bow remained in the Order’s possession until 1211 when it was given to the Grand Master of the Brotherhood of the Righteous, Pierre de Lemroix, for his aid in the defense of Jevaran. It was brought to Ultherst soon after.
译文: 阿哈拉尔的意志。单是这个名字，就足以令那些从圣战归来的人心生恐惧，而这种恐惧绝非没有缘由。\\n\\n贾德-哈巴尔人素以独特的战斗方式闻名于世。他们善用弯刀与布甲，其中最为人所知的或许是骑射手——那些无畏的战士手持短弓，驾着野性难驯的沙漠骏马冲锋陷阵。在这些战士中，无人比第三时代的贵族沙伊克·奥姆哈尔·布塔尔·阿德·坎达哈尔更令人闻风丧胆，敌人们只叫他“死神射手”。据说，凭借他的弓——阿哈拉尔的意志，他能在两百米外一箭射穿不敬神者的眼睛，将其击毙，他以此弓为异教之神屠戮了无数敌人。\\n\\n这把弓是坎达哈尔的明君拉夫马尼王为385年发动的圣战下令铸造的。第二次十字军东征期间，圣十字骑士团的成员从一具无名异教将领的尸身上搜获了这件圣物，使其落入了信众手中。那名将领如何得到如此神兵，无人得知，但此弓一直在骑士团手中，直至1211年——为表彰皮埃尔·德·勒姆罗瓦在杰瓦兰保卫战中的功绩，弓被赠予了正义兄弟会大团长。此后不久，它便被送到了乌尔瑟斯特。
