原文: This suit of armor was worn by the Archangel Gabriel himself, if some legends are to be believed. Supposedly the Emissary of the Lord gave it to the prophet, King David II of Ultherst in the year 999 to aid him in defending the Realm from a demonic incursion prophesied to occur at the turn of the millennium. The invasion never took place, but the armor remained in the possession of the ruling house of Ultherst and was worn in many battles through the Hundred Years War and multiple crusades. Rumor has it that the famous explorer Raymond Flayerd, who conquered the primitive empire of Azthallax, wore the armor in his holy conquest of the New World.
译文: 若某些传说可信，这套铠甲曾由大天使加百列亲自穿戴。据说，主的使者于999年将它赐予乌尔瑟斯特的先知——大卫二世国王，以帮助他保卫王国，抵御预言中将于千年之交降临的恶魔入侵。那场入侵从未发生，但铠甲一直为乌尔瑟斯特王族所持有，并在百年战争与多次十字军东征的无数战役中被穿戴。据传，那位征服了原始帝国阿兹塔拉克斯的著名探险家雷蒙德·弗莱尔德，曾在对新世界的神圣征服中穿着这套铠甲。

原文: When the Erstwick Crusade began, King Luther quickly realized his lightly armored militias would do little but die gracelessly in a akirmishwith the heavy cavalry of his enemies. According to legend, in one of Luther’s many fear-induced fever dreams, he met the angel Raphael, who advised him to journey to a forlorn fishing village on the shores of the Northern Sea. There, the angel claimed, Luther would find his people’s salvation.\n\\n When Luther arrived, he found little of use. The town was little more than a gathering of shanties, fallen into disrepair. As he prepared to leave, hopeless and broken, he saw fishermen spearing fish off the coast with long, wicked spears. The realization struck immediately. Luther ordered thousands of the specially-crafted spears for his armies—weapons that would soon be known as “pikes” for the town in which he’d found them, “Pike’s Landing.\\n\\nAt first, there were doubts about the efficiency of the new weapons among his men, and after a time, Luther feared they would refuse them in favor of more traditional swords and axes. Understanding that his men would never trust a spear in the command of a sword-wielding king, Luther had his own pike made. Beautiful and deadly, he had the weapon blessed by John Herman II, the Patriarch of the reformed Church of the True Word. At the behest of his men, Luther named the weapon the “Spike of Erstwick.”\\n\\n When the sun rose on the dawn of the first battle of the Erstwick Crusades, Luther hefted his pike and led his men with a cry and prayer into a veritable horde of marauding crusaders. Faced with the enemy’s heavy cavalry, Luther conquered unquestionably, dominating the field inboth Sadron and Meinheim. Horsemen the world over soon learned to fear the warrior king with the ten-foot reach. Luther’s name, and the name of his weapon, spread like wildfire across the civilized orld.\\n\\nThe Spike of Erstwick remained in the possession of Erstwick’s Kings until 1210, when it was stripped from the fallen king Darmont I. Though Erstwick won the war, the Ultherstians claimed the Spike of Erstwick as a spoil of war. It has remained in Ultherst ever since, longing to feel again Luther’s touch and the succulent warmth of horseflesh.
译文: 厄斯特威克十字军东征伊始，路德王便意识到，他那些轻甲民兵在与敌方重骑兵的遭遇战中，除了毫无尊严地战死沙场之外别无用处。据传，在路德因恐惧而生的无数高烧梦境之一中，他遇见了天使拉斐尔，天使劝他前往北海之滨一座荒凉的渔村。天使声称，路德将在那里找到子民的救赎。\n\\n 路德抵达之后，却发现几乎无可取之处。那座城镇不过是一片破败的棚屋聚落，早已年久失修。就在他心灰意冷、准备离去之际，他看见渔民们用又长又利的长矛在海岸边叉鱼。顿悟瞬间降临。路德为他的军队下令赶制了数千柄这种特制长矛——这些武器后来因发现它们的城镇"矛港"而得名"长矛"。\\n\\n起初，部下对新武器的效能心存疑虑，过了一段时间，路德甚至担心他们会拒绝使用，转而偏爱更传统的刀剑与战斧。路德深知，士兵们永远不会信任一个手持刀剑的国王所指挥的长矛，于是他命人打造了一柄属于自己的长矛。那柄长矛既美丽又致命，他请改革后真言教会宗主教约翰·赫尔曼二世为其祈福。应部下之请，路德将这柄武器命名为"厄斯特威克之刺"。\n\\n 当厄斯特威克十字军首战的黎明破晓，路德高举长矛，一声呐喊与祷告，率领部下冲入如潮水般涌来的劫掠十字军大军之中。面对敌人的重骑兵，路德毫无悬念地取得胜利，在萨德隆与迈因海姆两处战场上均牢牢掌控了战局。天下骑手很快便对这位攻击距离达十英尺的战士之王心生畏惧。路德之名，以及他武器之名，如野火般席卷整个文明世界。\\n\\n"厄斯特威克之刺"一直在厄斯特威克诸王的掌握之中，直至1210年，从战败的达尔蒙特一世身上被夺走。尽管厄斯特威克赢得了战争，乌尔瑟斯特人却将"厄斯特威克之刺"据为战利品。它此后便一直留在乌尔瑟斯特，渴盼再次感受路德的触碰，以及马肉那温热甘美的滋味。

原文: According to scripture, the man who would eventually become Saint George belonged to a rich family living in Cappadocia, the easternmost province of the Erebornian Empire. He served in the army of Emperor Diocletianus as an officer, accompanying the Emperor on his journey through the province. It seemed at one point that a promising future lay before the young officer. At a young age, his name was already known to perhaps the most powerful man in the world. All that changed, however in 118, when George accepted the True Faith and was mercilessly tortured to death for his beliefs.\\n\\n According to another legend, Saint George embraced the True Faith after he met a vicious dragon on some far flung battlefield. The ultimate incarnation of the beast, George fought for hours before the beast was slain, and only then because Gabriel himself had blessed the tip of his lance.\\n\\nRegardless of when George turned to the faith, the blessed lance was a thing of truth. It was lost after the Saint's death, but was found again during the First Crusade. Bearing the might of The Emissary himself, the lance became a symbol for the liberators of the Holy Grave. After the battle of Nashamir Fields, where the Crusaders suffered a terrible defeat at the hands of Omar II, the lance came into the possession of Aerin de Gublaire, a commander of the Brotherhood of the Righteous. When the crusaders returned from the Holy Lands, Gublaire brought the precious relic with him. It has remained in the Realm ever since.
译文:
据经文记载，日后成为圣乔治之人的男子出身于卡帕多西亚一个富裕家庭，该省是埃雷博恩人的帝国最东端的行省。他在戴克里先皇帝军中担任军官，随皇帝巡视该省。一度看来，这位年轻军官的前途无可限量。年纪轻轻，他的名字便已为世上最有权势之人所知。然而在118年，一切都因乔治皈依真信仰而改变——他因信仰被无情折磨致死。

 另一则传说称，圣乔治是在一片遥远战场上遭遇恶龙之后，才皈依真信仰的。那恶龙乃巨兽的终极化身，乔治与其鏖战数小时方将其斩杀——而能成此事，只因加百列亲自祝福了他的枪尖。

无论乔治何时转向信仰，那柄受祝福的长枪确有其事。圣人死后它便遗失，却在第一次十字军东征中重见天日。承载着使者本人的威能，这柄长枪成为解放圣地墓穴者的象征。在纳沙米尔原野战役中，十字军惨败于奥马尔二世之手，此后长枪落入正义兄弟会指挥官艾林·德·古布莱尔手中。十字军自圣地返回时，古布莱尔将这件珍贵圣物带回，此后一直留在王国。

原文: Glaives have been an integral part of warfare since 999, when the Erstwick Landsknechts under the command of King Luther drove off the Empire’s Crusaders with little more than their newly-adopted pikes. Similarly to Dies Irae, the relic of Commander Koliash of Monthart, which popularized the use of the halberd, Blood Bane was the relic that made glaives known throughout the faithful world.\\n\\nBlood Bane belonged to Philip of Kunttenburg, an infamous brigand and feared cutthroat descended from a noble Lochland family. Rumor has it that he partook in the Crusade against Erstwick in 999 to make amends for his sinful life—and almost found himself impaled on the end of a pike in a brutal counterattack that left many of his fellows dead. After the brush with death, Phillip decided to modernize arsenal and ordered a powerful glaive be made. After its completion, he had it enchanted by a monk named Gaspar, who was later accused of summoning of devils by the Papal Inquisition.\\n\\n Unaware of the dark enchantments tainting his weapon, Phillip found glory not on the battlefield, but along the royal roads, haunting villages and small towns with a roving army of brigans. His miserable life was ended in the Second Crusade against Erstwick, where once again, to atone for his sins, he was allowed to ride alongside the Crusaders. He was impaled by several pikes in a fruitless charge, and bled to death within minutes, or so the legend goes. After his death, Blood Bane was seized by the Ultherstian Crusaders who returned the fabled relic to the Realm. There, it has changed hands many times, eventually finding its way into the possession of one or more local noble families over the years.
译文:
长柄刀自999年起便是战争中不可或缺的一部分，当时厄斯特威克佣兵在路德王麾下，仅凭新采用的长矛便击退了帝国的十字军。与蒙塔尔特的科利亚什指挥官那柄使戟得以普及的圣物"末日审判"类似，"血之祸"是让长柄刀闻名于信仰世界的圣物。

血之祸曾属于孔滕堡的菲利普——一个臭名昭著的强盗、令人闻风丧胆的杀手，出身于洛奇兰一个贵族家庭。传言他在999年参加征讨厄斯特威克的十字军东征，是为了赎清自己罪恶的一生——却在一场惨烈的反击中险些被长矛刺穿，那场反击令他众多同伴丧命。死里逃生后，菲利普决定更新武库，命人打造了一柄强大的长柄刀。完工之后，他请一位名叫加斯帕尔的修士为其附魔，而此人后来被教廷宗教裁判所指控召唤恶魔。

 菲利普浑然不知自己的武器已被黑暗魔力玷污，他所获得的荣耀不在战场，而在王家大道之上——他率领一帮流窜的强盗，袭扰村庄与小镇。他悲惨的一生终结于征讨厄斯特威克的第二次十字军东征，为赎清罪孽，他再度获准与十字军并肩驰骋。他在一次徒劳的冲锋中被数根长矛刺穿，数分钟内便流血而亡——传说如此。他死后，血之祸被乌尔瑟斯特的十字军夺走，他们将这件传奇圣物归还王国。此后它在王国中数易其手，多年辗转之后，最终落入某个或某些地方贵族家族手中。

原文: Destroyer was the mighty axe of Vandor the Cruel, chieftain of the barbarian raiders who assaulted the Erebonian Empire in 395 of the Old Era. According to barbarian myths, the axe was forged by the semi-divine smiths Ethor and Unmair in the fabled city of Vallhard. There, barbarian gods and warrior kings waged war eternal between bouts of orgiastic feasting.\\n\\n Regardless of the veracity of ancient myths, the truth is wherever Vandor and Destroyer went, armies and cities fell. Even Bonorium, the Erebornian capital, eventually fell to the barbarian’s might. Vandor would later rename the empire Destroyer carved for him “Gubrinium.”\\n\\nAfter Vandor’s death, his two-bladed axe fell into the possession of Cleonus Flavius, a wandering merchant who brought it to his native city of Galibornium in the Filkland Peninsula. Destroyer remained in the Flavius family until the death of its last member, Honoricus Flavius, and was buried alongside him in the Flavius family tomb.
译文:
毁灭者是残暴的凡多尔的战斧，他是旧纪元395年袭击埃雷博恩帝国的蛮族劫掠者首领。据蛮族传说，这把战斧由半神铁匠埃索尔和翁迈尔在传奇之城瓦尔哈德锻造。在那里，蛮族神祇与武士之王在纵宴狂欢之间永无止息地征战厮杀。

 无论古老传说是否属实，事实是凡多尔与毁灭者所到之处，军队与城邦无不沦陷。甚至埃雷博恩人的首都博诺里姆也最终屈服于蛮族的威势。凡多尔后来将毁灭者为他征服的帝国重新命名为"古布里尼姆"。

凡多尔死后，他的双刃战斧落入了游商克莱奥努斯·弗拉维乌斯手中，他将其带回了故乡——菲尔克兰半岛的加利博尼姆。毁灭者在弗拉维乌斯家族中传承，直到末代成员霍诺里库斯·弗拉维乌斯去世，与他一同葬入了弗拉维乌斯家族墓穴。

原文: This powerful necklace, known as The Eye of God, was created in the mid 12th century by Paolus I, the first pope in the history of the Holy Mother Church. Over the years, the Eye became one of the symbols of the Papal Cathedra—the office of the highest Patriarch. Anyone who draped the Eye around his neck was said to be able to resolve disputes calmly, deadening the emotions of anyone in the room as if the eyes of God were upon them. Paolus used the Eye to great effect during his reign, but with the coming of his successor, the artifact was relegated to the Papal treasury in favor of new artifacts. Eventually, the Eye fell into the possession of the Ultherstian Archbishop, Melanius, with whom it was eventually buried in a tomb not far from Alvaron.
译文: 这条强大的项链名为上帝之眼，由圣母教会历史上首位教宗保禄一世于十二世纪中叶打造。多年以来，上帝之眼成为教宗宝座——最高宗主教之位——的象征之一。据说将它挂于颈上之人，能够从容化解争端，令满室之人的情绪归于沉寂，仿佛上帝的目光正在注视着他们。保禄一世在位期间将上帝之眼运用得极有成效，但在继承者登位后，这件圣物便被束之高阁，让位于新的圣物。最终，上帝之眼落入了乌尔瑟斯特大主教梅拉尼乌斯之手，与他一同葬入了阿尔瓦隆附近的一座墓穴中。

原文: According to the legends of people of Azthallaxu (a native kingdom of the New World), this ancient knife belonged to the god Guantharm who used it to kill the eternal snake, Onyx. From Onyx’s bowels, Guantharm created the Earth and sky. Although the legends are greatly exaggerated, the knife, “Onyx’s Bane” is in truth very ancient and very powerful. The famous conqueror, Raymond Flayerd, brought the weapon back to Calmariland with him after conquering the known New World. It was given, along with the rest of the treasures of Azthallax, to Carlos I, King of Calmariland. The treasure remained in Carlos’ possession until 1208, when pirates from the Island of Lost Souls pillaged the capitol. Onyx’s Bane, locked in the royal treasury, somehow vanished during the assault...
译文: 据阿兹塔拉克苏（新世界的一个原住王国）的传说，这把古老的刀属于神明甘萨姆，他用它杀死了永恒之蛇欧尼克斯。甘萨姆从欧尼克斯的腹中创造了大地与天空。尽管这些传说被极大地夸张了，这把名为"欧尼克斯之灾"的刀确实古老而强大。著名征服者雷蒙德·弗莱尔德在征服已知的新世界后，将这把武器带回了卡尔马里兰。它连同阿兹塔拉克苏的其余宝藏一起，被献给了卡尔马里兰国王卡洛斯一世。这些珍宝一直存于卡洛斯手中，直到1208年来自迷失灵魂岛的海盗洗劫了首都。锁在皇家宝库中的欧尼克斯之灾，在那场浩劫中不知去向……

原文: Superstitious commoners have long scared their children with rumors of a “Girdle of Death” which was supposedly crafted in Kluthmorr, the most powerful stronghold of Dark Prophets in the whole of the Empire. Though Kluthmorr lies in ruins today, in the Old Era, it was a city of fantastic wealth and power where cultists the world over would congregate to worship the Cursed Flame and the Lord of Chaos. Given its dark past, Kluthmorr eventually became the Dark Prophet’s stronghold during the Hundred Years War. Cloaked in demon-skin robes, they dwelled in the dungeons below the ruins of Kluthmorr, from whence they hoped to spread their corruption to ever corner of the world. The last inhabitant of the dungeon was Lucius, a self-proclaimed Dark Prophet who was also proven to be the leader of the Children of the New Order.\\n\\n The Cult was discovered in 1019, and many of its supporters were arrested and executed soon after. Lucius himself was taken into custody only after Kluthmorr, then marked for destruction, fell to the Imperial army. The “Girdle of Death,” the symbol of Lucius’ unholy might, was not found on his person. Rumor has it that he secreted the belt away to prevent the church from taking possession of it. Its powers, to this day, remain a mystery...
译文: 迷信的平民长期以"死亡腰带"的传说恐吓自己的孩子——据说它铸造于克鲁斯莫，全帝国最强大的暗黑先知要塞。如今克鲁斯莫虽已沦为废墟，但在旧纪元，它是一座富可敌国、权势赫赫的城市，来自世界各地的异教徒汇聚于此，崇拜诅咒之焰与混沌之主。正因其黑暗的过往，克鲁斯莫最终在百年战争期间成为暗黑先知的要塞。他们身披恶魔皮制成的长袍，栖身于克鲁斯莫废墟之下的地牢中，企图从那里将腐化蔓延至世界的每一个角落。地牢的最后一名居住者是卢修斯——一个自称暗黑先知的人，后被证实正是新秩序之子的领袖。\\n\\n 该邪教于1019年被发现，许多支持者很快遭到逮捕和处决。卢修斯本人是在克鲁斯莫——当时已被标记为摧毁目标——陷落于帝国军队之手后才被拘押的。作为卢修斯邪恶力量象征的"死亡腰带"并未在他身上找到。据传，他将腰带秘密藏匿，以防止教会将其据为己有。它的力量，至今仍是一个谜……

原文: This bracelet is an insignia of your newfound office. Wear the rank of Seneschal Knight of the Brotherhood of the Righteous with honor and distinction, always. God save the king!
译文: 此手镯是你新获职位的标志。永远以荣耀与卓越，佩戴正义兄弟会家宰骑士的头衔。愿上帝保佑国王！

原文: Downay the gardener confessed to being a member of the Children of the New Order. He also stated that he commited various crimes against God and King at the behest of the Seneschal, Jean de Guise of the Brotherhood of the Righteous.
译文: 园丁道奈供认自己是新秩序之子的成员。他还声称，自己受正义兄弟会的家宰让·德·吉斯之命，犯下种种亵渎上帝与国王的罪行。

原文: I found out that the unknown patron who put me on the trail of the Cult of the Children of the New Order's crimes was in fact seneschal of the Brotherhood of the Righteous, Jean de Guise.
译文: 我查明，那位指引我追查新秩序之子教团罪行的神秘雇主，正是正义兄弟会的家宰让·德·吉斯。

原文: Seneschal of the Brotherhood of the Righteous Jean de Guise confessed to his sins and admitted that he is a member of the heretical cult, the Children of the New Order. De Guise claims that he committed all of his crimes at the bidding of Cardinal Commendoni, the dark high priest of the cult.
译文: 正义兄弟会家宰让·德·吉斯忏悔了自己的罪过，承认自己是异端教团新秩序之子的成员。德·吉斯声称，他所犯的一切罪行均受该教团黑暗大祭司科门多尼枢机主教之命。

原文: Before he died, Kurth Ollmier allegedly mentioned that he had found a buyer for a certain book that had come into his possession after many years of strenuous searching.
译文: 据称，库尔特·奥尔米尔在死前提到，他经过多年艰苦搜寻才得到的一本书，已经找到了买家。

原文: Sven Larsen confessed that Seneschal of the Brotherhood of the Righteous, Jean de Guise, paid him to murder Eradim d'Chambrie.
译文: 斯文·拉森供认，正义兄弟会的家宰让·德·吉斯付钱雇他谋杀厄拉迪姆·德·尚布里。

原文: Baroness Linda van Gallagan confessed that she murdered the merchant Kurth Ollmier to retrieve the "Libre Daemonium," written by the dark prophet Lucius. She also confessed to poisoning Baroness Gwenn von Weill and then, along with Sam Riemann, removing the poor girl's body from its grave. All of this she did, supposedly, at the bidding of Judge Vallarian in order to perform a heretical mass. According to Van Gallagan, during the mass, the three allegedly invoked the fallen angel, Arthamon, the dreaded Demon of Fire and the Master of Ruin. I pray that the Baroness is mistaken.
译文: 琳达·范·加拉甘男爵夫人供认，她杀害了商人库尔特·奥尔米尔，以夺回暗黑先知卢修斯所著的《恶魔之书》。她还承认曾使格温·冯·维尔女男爵中毒，随后与萨姆·里曼一同将那可怜女孩的尸体从坟墓中移出。据称，这一切都是奉瓦拉里安法官之命，目的是举行一场异端弥撒。据范·加拉甘所说，在弥撒过程中，三人召唤了堕落天使阿尔萨蒙——那可怖的火焰恶魔与毁灭之主。我祈愿男爵夫人所言有误。

原文: I wish that I could have spoken with Kathryn Winhold. She, along with Corin Morray, witnessed the performing of heretical rite in the royal palace two years ago which left the crown prince, Louis, dead. Regrettably, she was executed that same year. There may yet be a way to discover what she knew, though... I should ask Cardinal Letti for guidance.
译文: 我真希望能与凯瑟琳·温霍尔德交谈。两年前，她与科琳·莫雷一同目睹了王宫中举行的异端仪式，王储路易斯因此丧命。遗憾的是，她已于同年被处决。不过，或许仍有办法查明她所知晓的一切……我该向莱蒂枢机主教请教。

原文: A vicious storm darkened the skies over Hillbrandt recently, but the accounts of its passing are as varied as they are strange. A handful of locals attest that it was an ordinary, albeit extremely powerful, gale. They say the winds were brutal, but not altogether outside the realm of the natural. Others swear that they saw the silhouettes of demons dancing in the clouds. The one fact that everyone seems to agree upon, however, is that the storm was accompanied by a terrible racket, a sound that many described as "a mad shrieking." No mention of demons should be taken lightly, and never have I witnessed a "shrieking" storm. I should press the townsfolk for more information.
译文: 近来一场凶猛的风暴使希尔布兰特的天空陷入黑暗，然而关于风暴过境的叙述却众说纷纭、离奇各异。少数当地人坚称那只是一场寻常的——尽管异常强烈的——狂风。他们说风势虽然凶猛，却并未完全超出自然的范畴。另一些人则发誓说，他们看见了恶魔的剪影在云中起舞。然而，所有人都似乎认同一个事实：风暴伴随着可怕的喧嚣，许多人将其描述为"疯狂的尖啸"。任何关于恶魔的说法都不应掉以轻心，而我从未见过会"尖啸"的风暴。我该向镇民们追问更多详情。

原文: Cardinal Severtinus asserts that there is treasure buried somewhere in the foothills of the Moonshine Mountains. Allegedly, this treasure contains a statuette of the barbarians' god, Bhelfelix. According to the Cardinal, there is a map in the possession of the treasure-hunter Hulph which details the location of both the statuette and the treasure. Luckily, Hulph is currently staying in Glatzburg.
译文: 塞尔维蒂努斯枢机主教断言，月光山脉的某处山麓埋藏着一批宝藏。据称，其中包含一尊蛮族之神贝尔费利克斯的小雕像。据枢机主教所言，寻宝者胡尔夫手中持有一张地图，详细标注了雕像与宝藏的位置。所幸，胡尔夫此刻正在格拉茨堡逗留。

原文: The villain Steinger told me where he and his accomplice, Vick Length, buried all of their stolen treasure. It's hidden near the Citadel of the Brotherhood of the Righteous, by the bridge spanning the dry brook. I also received a map of the treasure's location, in case I couldn't find it of my own accord. What sort of detective does he take me for?
译文: 恶徒施泰因格尔告诉了我，他和同党维克·伦斯将所有赃物埋藏于何处——藏在正义兄弟会城堡附近，横跨干涸溪流的那座桥旁。他还顺手给了我一张藏宝地图，仿佛我凭自己就找不到似的。他把我当成什么侦探了？

原文: I've heard that the comedian, Tinthan, was charged with the theft of the Monstrance of Saint Rhodrick. According to local legend, the man's no stranger to high profile theft, but the fool might very well lose his head over this one. For his sake, I pray the judge in his case has a wonderful sense of humor, or else a very weak heart.
译文: 我听说，丑角廷桑被控盗窃圣罗德里克圣体光。据当地传说，此人对这等惊天大案早已司空见惯，但这个蠢货很可能为此丢掉脑袋。看在他份上，我祈祷审理此案的法官要么极富幽默感，要么心疾缠身。

原文: Paolus Ventimus is certain that the method of obtaining St. Orthenius' fabled "Inquisitor" relic is detailed in the saint's own legend. According to Ventimus, the key to locating the device lies within the original text of St. Orthenius' tale, written centuries ago by the historian Killian. After Killian's death, the tale was rewritten several times until the truth of the Inquisitor relic was buried beneath the oft-quoted fairytale of a Protector who would rise to free the poor and the oppressed from their servitude. While certainly not the savior the people are hoping for, the true Protector will be the one they need most. Perhaps one day, they will see that.
译文: 保卢斯·文蒂穆斯确信，获得圣奥尔特尼乌斯那件传说中的"审判官"圣物的方法，在这位圣徒自己的传奇中已有详述。据文蒂穆斯所言，找到这件神器的关键，就藏在圣奥尔特尼乌斯故事的原始文本之中——那是数百年前由历史学家基利安写下的。基利安死后，这个故事被数次改写，直到审判官圣物的真相被埋没在那则被反复引用的童话之下：一位保护者将崛起，把穷人与受压迫者从奴役中解救出来。这位真正的保护者固然不是民众所期盼的救世主，却将是他们最需要的人。或许终有一日，他们会看清这一点。

原文: According to the assertions of the Royal Counselor, Verenicus, Crown Prince Louis is not truly dead. He was merely enthralled by a dark spell which left his spirit lingering feebly between the bounds of life and death. Because the Royal Apothecary could not distinguish true death from the unnatural stillness caused by the spell, the prince was declared dead and buried in the Royal Tomb alongside his sisters. No matter how small the chance, if the Crown Prince yet lives, I must find him and undo the spell which binds him. The Realm has never been in greater need of a ruler; in the meanwhile, I can only pray that Louis is the man his people desperately need him to be.
译文: 据皇家顾问维雷尼库斯所言，路易斯王储并非真正死去。他只是被一道黑暗的咒语所困，灵魂在生死之间微弱地徘徊。由于王室药剂师无法分辨真正的死亡与咒语造成的异常沉寂，王储便被宣告死亡，与他的姐妹们一同葬入王室陵墓。无论希望多么渺茫，只要路易斯王储尚在人世，我就必须找到他，解除束缚他的咒语。王国从未如此迫切地需要一位统治者；而在此期间，我只能祈祷路易斯正是他的人民拼命盼望他成为的那种人。

原文: Royal Counselor Verenicus confessed that he, along with Jean de Guise and Cardinal Commendoni, performed a heretical rite two years ago which left the Crown Prince, Louis, in a state of near-death.
译文: 皇家顾问维雷尼库斯供认，他与让·德·吉斯和科门多尼枢机主教于两年前举行了一场异端仪式，致使路易斯王储陷入濒死状态。

原文: There is supposedly a former paladin of the Brotherhood, a man by the name of Hanrey de Montreaux, who wanders the woodlands near Glatzburg, always in search of a fight. Locals say that he's become a fanatic—obsessed with the art of dueling—and that he uses his obsession as a means to commit murder. If the stories ring true, the man is apparently unbeatable. If I happen across him in my travels, I'll be sure to put those stories to the test.
译文: 据说，正义兄弟会曾有一位圣骑士，名叫汉瑞·德·蒙特罗，如今在格拉茨堡附近的林地中游荡，总在寻找对手比试。当地人说他已变得疯狂——痴迷于决斗之道——并将这份痴迷当作杀人的手段。倘若传言属实，此人似乎无人能敌。若我在旅途中与他相遇，定要亲自验证这些传闻。

原文: I promised the paladin Ulm von Grimschloss from the order of the Brotherhood of the Righteous that I would help him purge the dungeon beneath the ruins of an ancient pagan watchtower.
译文: 我答应正义兄弟会的圣骑士乌尔姆·冯·格林施洛斯，会帮助他净化古老异教瞭望塔废墟之下的地牢。

原文: If I solve the murder of His Majesty King Edward II and bring divine justice to his killers and their servants, I will be named the Seneschal of the Brotherhood of the Righteous. I shall not fail.
译文: 若我能侦破爱德华二世国王陛下的谋杀案，并对其凶手及其爪牙施以神圣正义，我将被任命为正义兄弟会的家宰。我绝不会失手。

原文: Inquisitorial Judge Vallarian has charged me with finding and arresting Master Edmond d'Arvias. By all accounts, it seems d’Arvias conspired with dark powers to kidnap the Diocesan Bishop Quentinus. Why would a Paladin Brother turn his back on his fellow man in such a dark time? The crime seems… almost out of place, but it is not for me to judge.
译文: 宗教裁判法官瓦拉里安委托我追捕并逮捕埃德蒙·达尔维亚斯大师。据各方所言，达尔维亚斯似乎与黑暗势力合谋，绑架了教区的昆提努斯主教。在如此黑暗的时局下，一位圣骑士兄弟为何会背弃同胞？这罪行似乎……几乎不像是他所为，但轮不到我来评判。

原文: Jean de Guise, the Seneschal of the Brotherhood of the Righteous, has ordered me to request permission of the Highest Inquisitorial Tribunal to arrest Grand Master Christoffer de Malamert on the basis of incriminating evidence. After receiving the Tribunal’s permission, I am to arrest him.
译文: 正义兄弟会的家宰让·德·吉斯命令我向最高宗教裁判庭申请许可，凭确凿证据逮捕克里斯托弗·德·马拉梅特大团长。获得裁判庭许可后，我便执行逮捕。

原文: Seneschal
译文: 家宰

原文: This spell causes 5*$$X$$d10 points of Fire Damage.\\n\\nAny being can be the target of this spell.\\n\\nIf a body of a heretic is turned to dust he can no longer be a threat to the faith or the Holy Mother Church. That is one of the most important dogmas based on the idea that if something does not exist it cannot do anything. Therefore the Inquisition searched for a formula which could instantly turn a heretic's body to dust, for such a formula would have been a great contribution in the fight for the protection of faith. And success came in 888 when at the execution of the self-appointed dark prophet Lucius of the cult of the Children of the New Order the stake was so wet with rain that it could not be lit up. The Inquisitor General Santini burst out with such an anger that he lit up the stake and a few people around it with a single word.
译文: 此法术造成 5*$$X$$d10 点火焰伤害。\\n\\n任何生物都可以成为此法术的目标。\\n\\n若异端的尸体化为灰烬，他便再也无法威胁信仰或圣母教会。这是最重要的教义之一，其核心思想是：不存在的东西无法做任何事。因此，宗教裁判所一直在寻找一种能将异端尸体瞬间化为灰烬的公式，因为这样的公式将为护教之战做出重大贡献。成功终于在888年到来——在处决自封的暗黑先知卢修斯、新秩序之子教团的领袖时，火刑柱被雨水浸得湿透，无法点燃。审判官总长桑蒂尼勃然大怒，仅用一个词便点燃了火刑柱和周围几个人。
